    74	private theorem msStrategyMeasurement_rejected_mul
    75	    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    76	    (P : Fin 9 → Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
    77	    (hP : ∀ j, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (P j))
    78	    (hcomm : ∀ i k l a b,
    79	      Commute ((P (msConstraintVars i k)).effect a)
    80	        ((P (msConstraintVars i l)).effect b))
    81	    (hmul : ∀ i k ab b,
    82	      (msConstraintJoint P hP hcomm i).effect ab *
    83	          (P (msConstraintVars i k)).effect b =
    84	        if parityTriple i ab k = b then
    85	          (msConstraintJoint P hP hcomm i).effect ab else 0)
    86	    (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) (a b : MsAnswer)
    87	    (hrej : msWinPredicate (.constraint i) (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) a b = false) :
    88	    ((msStrategyMeasurement P hP hcomm (.constraint i)).effect a) *
    89	      ((msStrategyMeasurement P hP hcomm
    90	        (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).effect b) = 0 := by
    91	  by_cases ha : a ∈ Set.range (fun ab => MsAnswer.triple (parityTriple i ab))
    92	  · rcases ha with ⟨ab, rfl⟩
    93	    rw [msStrategyMeasurement_constraint_triple]
    94	    by_cases hb : b ∈ Set.range (MsAnswer.bit : ZMod 2 → MsAnswer)
    95	    · rcases hb with ⟨c, rfl⟩
    96	      rw [msStrategyMeasurement_var_bit]
    97	      have hne : parityTriple i ab k ≠ c := by
    98	        simpa [msWinPredicate, parityTriple_sum,
    99	          msConstraintVars_exists_iff] using hrej
   100	      rw [hmul i k ab c]
   101	      simp [hne]
   102	    · rw [msStrategyMeasurement_var_zero _ _ _ _ hb]
   103	      simp
   104	  · rw [msStrategyMeasurement_constraint_zero _ _ _ _ ha]
   105	    simp

   128	private theorem msGame_support_incidence (x y : MsType)
   129	    (hxy : (x, y) ∈ msGameSymm.μ.support) :
   130	    (∃ i : Fin 6, ∃ k : Fin 3,
   131	      x = .constraint i ∧ y = .var (msConstraintVars i k)) ∨
   132	      ∃ i : Fin 6, ∃ k : Fin 3,
   133	        x = .var (msConstraintVars i k) ∧ y = .constraint i := by
   134	  change (x, y) ∈
   135	    Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : MsType × MsType =>
   136	      Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ msEdges) at hxy
   137	  have hedge : Sym2.mk x y ∈ msEdges := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxy).2
   138	  rw [msEdges] at hedge
   139	  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hedge with ⟨⟨i, k⟩, _, hik⟩
   140	  rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hik with hik | hik
   141	  · left
   142	    exact ⟨i, k, hik.1.symm, hik.2.symm⟩
   143	  · right
   144	    exact ⟨i, k, hik.2.symm, hik.1.symm⟩

   146	private theorem msGame_positive_incidence (x y : MsType)
   147	    (hxy : 0 < msGameSymm.μ.weight (x, y)) :
   148	    (∃ i : Fin 6, ∃ k : Fin 3,
   149	      x = .constraint i ∧ y = .var (msConstraintVars i k)) ∨
   150	      ∃ i : Fin 6, ∃ k : Fin 3,
   151	        x = .var (msConstraintVars i k) ∧ y = .constraint i := by
   152	  apply msGame_support_incidence x y
   153	  by_contra hnot
   154	  rw [msGameSymm.μ.outsideSupport (x, y) hnot] at hxy
   155	  exact (lt_irrefl 0 hxy)

   157	private theorem msStrategyMeasurement_commuting
   158	    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   159	    (P : Fin 9 → Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
   160	    (hP : ∀ j, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (P j))
   161	    (hcomm : ∀ i k l a b,
   162	      Commute ((P (msConstraintVars i k)).effect a)
   163	        ((P (msConstraintVars i l)).effect b)) :
   164	    IsCommutingOn msGameSymm.μ
   165	      (msStrategyMeasurement P hP hcomm)
   166	      (msStrategyMeasurement P hP hcomm) := by

   169	  · rcases hxy with ⟨i, k, rfl, rfl⟩
   170	    exact msStrategyMeasurement_incident_commute P hP hcomm i k a b
   171	  · rcases hxy with ⟨i, k, rfl, rfl⟩
   172	    exact (msStrategyMeasurement_incident_commute P hP hcomm i k b a).symm

   196	/-- Every effect in the perfect Magic Square measurement family is symmetric
   197	when the nine underlying cell measurements have symmetric effects. -/
   198	theorem msStrategyMeasurement_effect_transpose
   199	    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   200	    (P : Fin 9 → Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
   201	    (hP : ∀ j, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (P j))
   202	    (hcomm : ∀ i k l a b,
   203	      Commute ((P (msConstraintVars i k)).effect a)
   204	        ((P (msConstraintVars i l)).effect b))
   205	    (hPt : ∀ j b, ((P j).effect b)ᵀ = (P j).effect b)
   206	    (x : MsType) (a : MsAnswer) :
   207	    ((msStrategyMeasurement P hP hcomm x).effect a)ᵀ =
   208	      (msStrategyMeasurement P hP hcomm x).effect a := by
   209	  cases x with
   210	  | var j =>
   211	      exact postprocess_effect_transpose (P j) MsAnswer.bit (hPt j) a
   212	  | constraint i =>
   213	      exact postprocess_effect_transpose (msConstraintJoint P hP hcomm i)
   214	        (fun ab => .triple (parityTriple i ab))
   215	        (msConstraintJoint_effect_transpose P hP hcomm hPt i) a

   217	private theorem heteroKron_mulVec_epr_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero
   218	    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V]
   219	    (E F : Op V) (hFt : Fᵀ = F) (hEF : E * F = 0) :
   220	    (heteroKron E F).mulVec (eprState V) = 0 := by
   221	  have hfactor : heteroKron E F =
   222	      heteroKron E 1 * heteroKron 1 F := by
   223	    rw [heteroKron_mul]
   224	    simp
   225	  rw [hfactor, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
   226	    ← epr_action_eq_of_transpose F hFt, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
   227	    heteroKron_mul, hEF]
   228	  have hz : heteroKron (0 : Op V) (1 : Op V) = 0 := by
   229	    ext ⟨i, k⟩ ⟨j, l⟩
   230	    simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
   231	  simp only [mul_one]
   232	  rw [hz]
   233	  exact Matrix.zero_mulVec _

   235	private theorem sum_heteroKron_measurement_effects
   236	    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   237	    {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
   238	    (M : Measurement A V) (N : Measurement B V) :
   239	    ∑ a : A, ∑ b : B, heteroKron (M.effect a) (N.effect b) = 1 := by
   240	  calc
   241	    ∑ a : A, ∑ b : B, heteroKron (M.effect a) (N.effect b) =
   242	        heteroKron (∑ a : A, M.effect a) (∑ b : B, N.effect b) := by
   243	      ext p q
   244	      rcases p with ⟨p₁, p₂⟩
   245	      rcases q with ⟨q₁, q₂⟩
   246	      simp only [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply,
   247	        Matrix.sum_apply]
   248	      exact (Finset.sum_mul_sum Finset.univ Finset.univ
   249	        (fun a => M.effect a p₁ q₁) (fun b => N.effect b p₂ q₂)).symm
   250	    _ = heteroKron 1 1 := by rw [M.sum_eq_one, N.sum_eq_one]
   251	    _ = 1 := heteroKron_one_one

   253	private theorem sum_apply_measurement_effects
   254	    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   255	    {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
   256	    (M : Measurement A V) (N : Measurement B V)
   257	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (V × V)) :
   258	    ∑ a : A, ∑ b : B,
   259	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (M.effect a) (N.effect b)) psi = psi := by
   260	  calc
   261	    ∑ a : A, ∑ b : B,
   262	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (M.effect a) (N.effect b)) psi =
   263	      applyOperatorToState
   264	        (∑ a : A, ∑ b : B, heteroKron (M.effect a) (N.effect b)) psi := by
   265	          simp [applyOperatorToState]
   266	    _ = applyOperatorToState 1 psi := by
   267	      rw [sum_heteroKron_measurement_effects M N]
   268	    _ = psi := by simp [applyOperatorToState]

   270	private theorem sum_born_weights_eq_one
   271	    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   272	    {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
   273	    (M : Measurement A V) (N : Measurement B V)
   274	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (V × V)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) :
   275	    ∑ a : A, ∑ b : B,
   276	        (inner ℂ psi
   277	          (applyOperatorToState
   278	            (heteroKron (M.effect a) (N.effect b)) psi)).re = 1 := by
   279	  calc
   280	    ∑ a : A, ∑ b : B,
   281	        (inner ℂ psi
   282	          (applyOperatorToState
   283	            (heteroKron (M.effect a) (N.effect b)) psi)).re =
   284	      (inner ℂ psi
   285	        (∑ a : A, ∑ b : B,
   286	          applyOperatorToState
   287	            (heteroKron (M.effect a) (N.effect b)) psi)).re := by
   288	              simp only [inner_sum, Complex.re_sum]
   289	    _ = (inner ℂ psi psi).re := by rw [sum_apply_measurement_effects M N psi]
   290	    _ = 1 := by
   291	      calc
   292	        (inner ℂ psi psi).re = ‖psi‖ ^ 2 :=
   293	          inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) psi
   294	        _ = 1 := by simp [hpsi]

   339	theorem accepted_born_weights_eq_one
   340	    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V]
   341	    (P : Fin 9 → Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
   342	    (hP : ∀ j, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (P j))
   343	    (hcomm : ∀ i k l a b,
   344	      Commute ((P (msConstraintVars i k)).effect a)
   345	        ((P (msConstraintVars i l)).effect b))
   346	    (hmul : ∀ i k ab b,
   347	      (msConstraintJoint P hP hcomm i).effect ab *
   348	          (P (msConstraintVars i k)).effect b =
   349	        if parityTriple i ab k = b then

   130	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:184-189`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:162-174`. -/
   131	def SymmetricStrategy.IsConsistent {G : SymmetricGame}
   132	    (S : SymmetricStrategy G) : Prop :=
   133	  ∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsConsistentOn (S.M x) S.ψ
   134	
   135	/-- The PCC predicate `def:spcc`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:193-198`,
   136	paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:176-180`. -/
   137	def Strategy.IsPCC {G : Game} {ι : Type*}
   138	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   139	    (μ : Distribution (G.QuestionA × G.QuestionB))
   140	    (A : G.QuestionA → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement G.AnswerA ι)
   141	    (B : G.QuestionB → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement G.AnswerB ι)
   142	  (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) : Prop :=
   143	  (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A x)) ∧
   144	    (∀ y, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (B y)) ∧
   145	    IsConsistentStrategyOn A B ψ ∧ IsCommutingOn μ A B

   147	/-- The SPCC predicate `def:spcc`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:193-198`,
   148	paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:176-180`. -/
   149	def SymmetricStrategy.IsSPCC {G : SymmetricGame}
   150	  (S : SymmetricStrategy G) : Prop :=
   151	  (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (S.M x)) ∧ S.IsConsistent ∧
   152	    IsCommutingOn G.μ S.M S.M

   159	/-- The real quadratic form of an operator evaluated on a finite vector. -/
   160	private def vectorQForm {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   161	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ I) (A : Op I) : ℝ :=
   162	  (inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A ψ)).re
   163	
   164	/-- Embed a bipartite state into the distinguished Naimark ancilla coordinates. -/
   165	private def padState
   166	    {I J α β : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   167	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   168	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
   169	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) :
   170	    EuclideanSpace ℂ ((I × Option α) × (J × Option β)) :=
   171	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv ((I × Option α) × (J × Option β)) ℂ).symm
   172	    (fun p => if p.1.2 = none ∧ p.2.2 = none then ψ.ofLp (p.1.1, p.2.1) else 0)
   173	
   174	/-- Padding a state by zero ancilla coordinates preserves its norm. -/
   175	private theorem padState_norm
   176	    {I J α β : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   177	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   178	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
   179	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) :
   180	    ‖padState (α := α) (β := β) ψ‖ = ‖ψ‖ := by
   181	  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
   182	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   183	  simp [padState, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   184	
   185	/-- The padded-state quadratic form depends only on the distinguished
   186	compression of each local operator. -/
   187	private theorem stateQForm_padState
   188	    {I J α β : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   189	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   190	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
   191	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   192	    (A : Op I) (B : Op J)
   193	    (A' : Op (I × Option α)) (B' : Op (J × Option β))
   194	    (hA : ∀ i j, A' (i, none) (j, none) = A i j)
   195	    (hB : ∀ i j, B' (i, none) (j, none) = B i j) :
   196	    vectorQForm (padState (α := α) (β := β) ψ) (heteroKron A' B') =
   197	      vectorQForm ψ (heteroKron A B) := by
   198	  unfold vectorQForm
   199	  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
   200	  change Complex.re (∑ p : (I × Option α) × (J × Option β),
   201	      (∑ q : (I × Option α) × (J × Option β),
   202	        heteroKron A' B' p q *
   203	          (padState (α := α) (β := β) ψ).ofLp q) *
   204	        star (padState (α := α) (β := β) ψ).ofLp p) =
   205	    Complex.re (∑ p : I × J,
   206	      (∑ q : I × J, heteroKron A B p q * ψ.ofLp q) * star ψ.ofLp p)
   207	  simp [padState, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Fintype.sum_prod_type, hA, hB]

   209	/-- Choose the one-measurement Naimark dilation data for a POVM. -/
   210	private def oneMeasData
   211	    {α I : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   212	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   213	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I) : OneMeasNaimarkData α I :=
   214	  Classical.choose (oneMeasNaimark M.toSubmeasurement)
   215	
   216	/-- The source submeasurement of the chosen Naimark data is the original POVM. -/
   217	private theorem oneMeasData_source_effect
   218	    {α I : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   219	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   220	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I) :
   221	    (oneMeasData M).source.effect = M.effect := by
   222	  exact congrArg MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement.effect
   223	    (Classical.choose_spec (oneMeasNaimark M.toSubmeasurement))
   224	
   225	/-- Complete the Naimark projectors at one outcome to obtain a projective POVM. -/
   226	private def dilatedMeasurement
   227	    {α I : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   228	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   229	    (a₀ : α) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I) :
   230	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (I × Option α) :=
   231	  let P := completeAtOutcomeProj (oneMeasData M).toProjSubMeas a₀
   232	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne P.outcome P.outcome_pos <| by
   233	    rw [P.sum_eq_total, P.total_eq_one]
   234	
   235	/-- Every effect of the completed Naimark measurement is a projection. -/
   236	private theorem dilatedMeasurement_isProjective
   237	    {α I : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   238	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   239	    (a₀ : α) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I) :
   240	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (dilatedMeasurement a₀ M) := by
   241	  intro a
   242	  let P := completeAtOutcomeProj (oneMeasData M).toProjSubMeas a₀
   243	  change IsProj (P.outcome a)
   244	  exact
   245	    { isIdempotentElem := P.proj a
   246	      isSelfAdjoint :=
   247	        (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (P.outcome_pos a)).isHermitian.eq }
   248	
   249	/-- Compressing a completed Naimark effect to the distinguished ancilla
   250	coordinate recovers the original POVM effect. -/
   251	private theorem dilatedMeasurement_compression
   252	    {α I : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   253	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   254	    (a₀ a : α) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I) (i j : I) :
   255	    (dilatedMeasurement a₀ M).effect a (i, none) (j, none) = M.effect a i j := by
   256	  let D := oneMeasData M
   257	  let P := D.toProjSubMeas
   258	  have hcompress (b : α) : P.outcome b (i, none) (j, none) = M.effect b i j := by
   259	    change D.liftedEffect (some b) (i, none) (j, none) = M.effect b i j
   260	    rw [D.compression_none_none]
   260	    rw [D.compression_none_none]
   261	    exact congrArg (fun X : Op I => X i j)
   262	      (congrFun (oneMeasData_source_effect M) b)
   263	  have htotal : P.total (i, none) (j, none) = (1 : Op I) i j := by
   264	    rw [← P.sum_eq_total]
   265	    simp_rw [Matrix.sum_apply, hcompress]
   266	    simpa [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrArg (fun X : Op I => X i j) M.sum_eq_one
   267	  simp only [dilatedMeasurement, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne]
   268	  change ((completeAtOutcomeProj P a₀).toMeasurement).outcome a
   269	      (i, none) (j, none) = M.effect a i j
   270	  rw [completeAtOutcomeProj_toMeasurement]
   271	  simp only [completeAtOutcome]
   272	  by_cases ha : a = a₀
   273	  · subst a
   274	    rw [dif_pos rfl]
   275	    rw [Matrix.add_apply, hcompress, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply, htotal]
   276	    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij, Matrix.one_apply]
   277	  · rw [dif_neg ha]
   278	    exact hcompress a

   280	/-- A unit vector has a nonempty coordinate type. -/
   281	private theorem nonempty_of_unit_vector
   282	    {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   283	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ I) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) : Nonempty I := by
   284	  classical
   285	  by_contra hI
   286	  haveI : IsEmpty I := not_nonempty_iff.mp hI
   287	  have hzero : ψ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
   288	  rw [hzero, norm_zero] at hψ
   289	  norm_num at hψ
   290	
   291	/-- A POVM on a nonzero finite-dimensional space has an outcome. -/
   292	private theorem measurement_outcome_nonempty
   293	    {α I : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Nonempty I]
   294	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I) : Nonempty α := by
   295	  classical
   296	  by_contra hα
   297	  haveI : IsEmpty α := not_nonempty_iff.mp hα
   298	  let i : I := Classical.choice inferInstance
   299	  have heq := congrArg (fun X : Op I => X i i) M.sum_eq_one
   300	  simp [Matrix.sum_apply] at heq

   302	/-- Dilate both local POVM families of a strategy and pad its state by the two
   303	distinguished ancilla coordinates. -/
   304	private def projectiveDilation {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   305	    (a₀ : G.AnswerA) (b₀ : G.AnswerB) : Strategy G where
   306	  ιA := S.ιA × Option G.AnswerA
   307	  ιB := S.ιB × Option G.AnswerB
   308	  ψ := padState S.ψ
   309	  ψ_norm := (padState_norm S.ψ).trans S.ψ_norm
   310	  A := fun x => dilatedMeasurement a₀ (S.A x)
   311	  B := fun y => dilatedMeasurement b₀ (S.B y)
   312	
   313	/-- The local measurements of the Naimark-dilated strategy are projective. -/
   314	private theorem projectiveDilation_isProjective {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   315	    (a₀ : G.AnswerA) (b₀ : G.AnswerB) :
   316	    (projectiveDilation S a₀ b₀).IsProjective := by
   317	  constructor
   318	  · intro x
   319	    exact dilatedMeasurement_isProjective a₀ (S.A x)
   320	  · intro y
   321	    exact dilatedMeasurement_isProjective b₀ (S.B y)
   322	
   323	/-- Naimark dilation and state padding preserve every game correlation and
   324	hence preserve the strategy value. -/
   325	private theorem projectiveDilation_value {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   326	    (a₀ : G.AnswerA) (b₀ : G.AnswerB) :
   327	    (projectiveDilation S a₀ b₀).value = S.value := by
   328	  unfold Strategy.value
   329	  apply avgOver_congr
   330	  intro xy
   331	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   332	  intro a _
   333	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   334	  intro b _
   335	  by_cases hw : G.decide xy.1 xy.2 a b
   336	  · simp only [hw, if_true]
   337	    exact stateQForm_padState (α := G.AnswerA) (β := G.AnswerB)
   338	      S.ψ ((S.A xy.1).effect a) ((S.B xy.2).effect b)
   339	      ((dilatedMeasurement a₀ (S.A xy.1)).effect a)
   340	      ((dilatedMeasurement b₀ (S.B xy.2)).effect b)
   341	      (dilatedMeasurement_compression a₀ a (S.A xy.1))
   342	      (dilatedMeasurement_compression b₀ b (S.B xy.2))
   343	  · simp [hw]

   345	/-- Form the block-diagonal direct sum of two POVMs with the same outcome type. -/
   346	private def blockMeasurement
   347	    {α I J : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   348	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   349	    (A : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I)
   350	    (B : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α J) :
   351	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (Sum I J) :=
   352	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
   353	    (fun a => MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock (A.effect a) (B.effect a))
   354	    (fun a => MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock_nonneg (A.pos a) (B.pos a))
   355	    (by
   356	      calc
   357	        (∑ a : α, MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock
   358	            (A.effect a) (B.effect a)) =
   359	          MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock
   360	            (∑ a : α, A.effect a) (∑ a : α, B.effect a) := by
   361	              simpa using MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock_finset_sum
   362	                Finset.univ A.effect B.effect
   363	        _ = 1 := by
   364	          rw [A.sum_eq_one, B.sum_eq_one,
   365	            MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock_one])
   366	
   367	/-- A direct sum of projective POVMs is projective. -/
   368	private theorem blockMeasurement_isProjective
   369	    {α I J : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   370	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   371	    (A : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I)
   372	    (B : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α J)
   373	    (hA : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective A)
   374	    (hB : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective B) :
   375	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (blockMeasurement A B) := by
   376	  intro a
   377	  change IsProj (MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock
   378	    (A.effect a) (B.effect a))
   379	  refine { isIdempotentElem := ?_, isSelfAdjoint := ?_ }
   380	  · change MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock (A.effect a) (B.effect a) *
   381	        MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock (A.effect a) (B.effect a) = _
   382	    rw [MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock_mul,
   383	      (hA a).isIdempotentElem.eq, (hB a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   384	  · change (MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock
   385	        (A.effect a) (B.effect a))ᴴ = _
   386	    rw [MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock_conjTranspose,
   387	      (hA a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
   388	      (hB a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]
   389	
   390	/-- Put a bipartite vector in the two exchanged off-diagonal sectors of the
   391	local direct sum, with equal amplitudes. -/
   392	private def symmState
   393	    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   394	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   395	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) :
   396	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (Sum I J × Sum I J) :=
   397	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Sum I J × Sum I J) ℂ).symm fun p =>
   398	    match p with
   399	    | (Sum.inl i, Sum.inr j) => (Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℂ) * ψ.ofLp (i, j)
   400	    | (Sum.inr j, Sum.inl i) => (Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℂ) * ψ.ofLp (i, j)
   401	    | _ => 0
   402	
   403	/-- The direct-sum state is fixed by exchanging its two local tensor factors. -/
   404	private theorem symmState_swap
   405	    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   406	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   407	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) :
   408	    reindexState (Equiv.prodComm (Sum I J) (Sum I J)) (symmState ψ) =
   409	      symmState ψ := by
   410	  apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Sum I J × Sum I J) ℂ).injective
   411	  funext p
   412	  rcases p with ⟨p, q⟩
   413	  cases p <;> cases q <;> rfl
   414	
   415	/-- Coordinate formula for the direct-sum symmetric state. -/
   416	private theorem symmState_apply
   417	    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   418	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   419	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (p : Sum I J × Sum I J) :
   420	    (symmState ψ).ofLp p =
   421	      match p with
   422	      | (Sum.inl i, Sum.inr j) => (Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℂ) * ψ.ofLp (i, j)
   423	      | (Sum.inr j, Sum.inl i) => (Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℂ) * ψ.ofLp (i, j)
   424	      | _ => 0 := by
   425	  simp [symmState]
   426	
   427	/-- The equal-amplitude direct-sum symmetrization preserves the vector norm. -/
   428	private theorem symmState_norm
   429	    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   430	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   431	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) : ‖symmState ψ‖ = ‖ψ‖ := by
   432	  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
   433	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   434	  simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_sum_type, symmState_apply]
   435	  rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2)]
   436	  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt 2 / 2) ^ 2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
   437	    rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
   438	    norm_num
   439	  simp_rw [mul_pow, hsqrt]
   440	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   441	  simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
   442	  ring_nf
   443	  exact Finset.sum_comm

   445	/-- Scaling both entries of a finite sesquilinear sum contributes the scalar
   446	`c * star c`. -/
   447	private theorem sesquilinear_sum_smul
   448	    {K L : Type*} [Fintype K] [Fintype L]
   449	    (c : ℂ) (f : K → L → ℂ) (v : L → ℂ) (w : K → ℂ) :
   450	    (∑ p : K, (∑ q : L, f p q * (c * v q)) * star (c * w p)) =
   451	      c * star c * ∑ p : K, (∑ q : L, f p q * v q) * star (w p) := by
   452	  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   453	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   454	  intro p _
   455	  rw [star_mul]
   456	  have hinner : (∑ q : L, f p q * (c * v q)) =
   457	      c * ∑ q : L, f p q * v q := by
   458	    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   459	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   460	    intro q _
   461	    ring
   462	  rw [hinner]
   463	  ring

   465	/-- A block tensor quadratic form on the symmetric state is the average of the
   466	two crossed quadratic forms on the original state. -/
   467	private theorem vectorQForm_symmState_block
   468	    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   469	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   470	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   471	    (A C : Op I) (B D : Op J) :
   472	    vectorQForm (symmState ψ)
   473	        (heteroKron
   474	          (MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock A B)
   475	          (MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock C D)) =
   476	      (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
   477	        (vectorQForm ψ (heteroKron A D) + vectorQForm ψ (heteroKron C B)) := by
   478	  unfold vectorQForm
   479	  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct,
   480	    EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
   481	  change Complex.re (∑ p : Sum I J × Sum I J,
   482	      (∑ q : Sum I J × Sum I J,
   483	        heteroKron
   484	          (MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock A B)
   485	          (MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock C D) p q *
   486	            (symmState ψ).ofLp q) * star (symmState ψ).ofLp p) =
   487	    (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
   488	      (Complex.re (∑ p : I × J,
   489	          (∑ q : I × J, heteroKron A D p q * ψ.ofLp q) * star ψ.ofLp p) +
   490	        Complex.re (∑ p : I × J,
   491	          (∑ q : I × J, heteroKron C B p q * ψ.ofLp q) * star ψ.ofLp p))
   492	  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
   493	  simp only [Pi.star_apply, symmState_apply]
   494	  simp only [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
   495	  simp only [
   496	    MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock_inl_inl,
   497	    MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock_inl_inr,
   498	    MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock_inr_inl,
   499	    MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat.localDirectSumBlock_inr_inr,
   500	    zero_mul, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
   501	  let c : ℂ := Real.sqrt 2 / 2
   502	  have hfirst :
   503	      (∑ i : I, ∑ j : J,
   504	        (∑ k : I, ∑ l : J, A i k * D j l * (c * ψ.ofLp (k, l))) *
   505	          star (c * ψ.ofLp (i, j))) =
   506	        c * star c *
   507	          ∑ i : I, ∑ j : J,
   508	            (∑ k : I, ∑ l : J, A i k * D j l * ψ.ofLp (k, l)) *
   509	              star (ψ.ofLp (i, j)) := by
   510	    simpa only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   511	      Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply] using

theorem pauliQuestionDistribution_symm (P : AdmissibleParams)
    (x y : PauliQuestion P) :
    (pauliQuestionDistribution P).weight (x, y) =
      (pauliQuestionDistribution P).weight (y, x) := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty PauliEdge := pauliEdge_nonempty
  have hcard : ∀ c : PauliQuestion P × PauliQuestion P,
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (PauliEdge × PauliSpace P)).filter fun q =>

            (q.1.val.2, pauliCL P q.1.val.2 q.2)) = c.swap).card := by

/-- Symmetry of the Pauli decision predicate in the symmetric game appearing in
`lem:pauli-completeness`. -/
theorem pauliWinPredicate_symm (P : AdmissibleParams)
    (x y : PauliQuestion P) (a b : PauliAnswer P) :
    pauliWinPredicate P x y a b = pauliWinPredicate P y x b a := by
  obtain ⟨tA, xA⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨tB, xB⟩ := y
  by_cases hT : tA = tB
  · subst hT
    simp only [pauliWinPredicate]
    rw [Bool.and_comm (validPauliAnswer tA b) (validPauliAnswer tA a)]
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · simp [hab]
    · simp [hab, Ne.symm hab]
  · cases hvA : validPauliAnswer tA a
    · simp [pauliWinPredicate, hvA]
    · cases hvB : validPauliAnswer tB b
      · simp [pauliWinPredicate, hvB]
      · simp only [pauliWinPredicate, hvA, hvB, Bool.and_self,
          if_neg hT, if_neg (Ne.symm hT)]
        rcases tA with (_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|_|(iA|jA) <;>
          rcases a with uA|fA|gA|bitsA|bitA|trA|hhA <;>
          (try exact Bool.noConfusion hvA) <;>
          rcases tB with (_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|_|(iB|jB) <;>
          rcases b with uB|fB|gB|bitsB|bitB|trB|hhB <;>
          (try exact Bool.noConfusion hvB) <;>
          rfl

theorem pauliBasisTestSymm_toGame (P : AdmissibleParams) :

   220	  | .inl (.inl (.inr _)) => 0

   262	private theorem isCondLinearOn_one_of_linear {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
   263	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (L : (ι → K) →ₗ[K] (ι → K)) :
   264	    IsCondLinearOn K Finset.univ 1 (fun x => L x) := by
   265	  refine ⟨.succ Finset.univ L (fun _ i hi => absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) hi)
   266	      (fun _ => .zero), ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, fun _ => trivial⟩, ?_⟩
   267	  funext x
   268	  have hx : coordinateRestriction (Finset.univ : Finset ι) x = x := by
   269	    funext i
   270	    simp [coordinateRestriction]
   271	  show L (coordinateRestriction Finset.univ x) + 0 = L x
   272	  rw [hx, add_zero]

   274	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: extend a coefficient vector along an injective
   275	reindexing of registers, setting every coordinate outside the image to zero.
   276	Together with the lemmas that follow it, this supports the transport of
   277	conditional linearity between the register spaces of `def:cl-func`,
   278	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1168-1178`,
   279	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`. -/
   280	private def clExtend {K κ ι : Type*} [Zero K] (f : κ → ι) (u : κ → K) : ι → K :=
   281	  Function.extend f u 0
   282	
   283	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the extension recovers the original
   284	coordinates along an injective reindexing. -/
   285	private theorem clExtend_apply {K κ ι : Type*} [Zero K] {f : κ → ι}
   286	    (hf : Function.Injective f) (u : κ → K) (k : κ) :
   287	    clExtend f u (f k) = u k :=
   288	  hf.extend_apply u 0 k
   289	
   290	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the extension vanishes at any coordinate
   291	outside the image of the reindexing. -/
   292	private theorem clExtend_eq_zero_of_not_mem {K κ ι : Type*} [Zero K]
   293	    (f : κ → ι) (u : κ → K) (i : ι) (h : ∀ k, f k ≠ i) :
   294	    clExtend f u i = 0 :=
   295	  Function.extend_apply' u (0 : ι → K) i
   296	    (fun hex => h hex.choose hex.choose_spec)
   297	
   298	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: restriction along an injective reindexing
   299	inverts the extension. -/
   300	private theorem clExtend_comp {K κ ι : Type*} [Zero K] {f : κ → ι}
   301	    (hf : Function.Injective f) (u : κ → K) :
   302	    (fun k => clExtend f u (f k)) = u :=
   303	  funext fun k => clExtend_apply hf u k
   304	
   305	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the extension of the zero vector vanishes. -/
   306	private theorem clExtend_zero {K κ ι : Type*} [Zero K] {f : κ → ι}
   307	    (hf : Function.Injective f) : clExtend f (0 : κ → K) = 0 := by
   308	  funext i
   309	  by_cases h : ∃ k, f k = i
   310	  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h
   311	    simp [clExtend_apply hf]
   312	  · simp [clExtend, Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ h]
   313	
   314	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the extension is additive. -/
   315	private theorem clExtend_add {K κ ι : Type*} [AddZeroClass K] {f : κ → ι}
   316	    (hf : Function.Injective f) (u v : κ → K) :
   317	    clExtend f (u + v) = clExtend f u + clExtend f v := by
   318	  funext i
   319	  by_cases h : ∃ k, f k = i
   320	  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h
   321	    simp [clExtend_apply hf]
   322	  · simp [clExtend, Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ h]
   323	
   324	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the extension commutes with scalars. -/
   325	private theorem clExtend_smul {K κ ι : Type*} [Semiring K] {f : κ → ι}
   326	    (hf : Function.Injective f) (c : K) (u : κ → K) :
   327	    clExtend f (c • u) = c • clExtend f u := by
   328	  funext i
   329	  by_cases h : ∃ k, f k = i
   330	  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h
   331	    simp [clExtend_apply hf]
   332	  · simp [clExtend, Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ h]
   333	
   334	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: transport a linear map of coefficient vectors
   335	along an injective reindexing of registers; see `clExtend`.  Supports
   336	`def:cl-func`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1168-1178`,
   337	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`. -/
   338	private def clReindexLinear {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K] {f : κ → ι}
   339	    (hf : Function.Injective f) (L : (κ → K) →ₗ[K] (κ → K)) :
   340	    (ι → K) →ₗ[K] (ι → K) where
   341	  toFun x := clExtend f (L (fun k => x (f k)))
   342	  map_add' x y := by
   343	    show clExtend f (L (fun k => (x + y) (f k))) =
   344	      clExtend f (L (fun k => x (f k))) + clExtend f (L (fun k => y (f k)))
   345	    have h : (fun k => (x + y) (f k)) =
   346	        (fun k => x (f k)) + (fun k => y (f k)) := rfl
   347	    rw [h, map_add, clExtend_add hf]
   348	  map_smul' c x := by
   349	    show clExtend f (L (fun k => (c • x) (f k))) =
   350	      c • clExtend f (L (fun k => x (f k)))
   351	    have h : (fun k => (c • x) (f k)) = c • (fun k => x (f k)) := rfl
   352	    rw [h, map_smul, clExtend_smul hf]
   353	
   354	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: transport a conditionally linear syntax tree
   355	along an injective reindexing of registers; see `clExtend`.  Supports
   356	`def:cl-func`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1168-1178`,
   357	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`. -/
   358	private def clReindexTerm {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
   359	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
   360	    {ell : ℕ} → CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell → CondLinearTerm K (ι := ι) ell
   361	  | _, .zero => .zero
   362	  | _, .succ S₁ L₁ h rest =>
   363	      .succ (S₁.image f) (clReindexLinear hf L₁)
   364	        (by
   365	          intro x i hi
   366	          by_cases hex : ∃ k, f k = i
   367	          · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hex
   368	            have hk : k ∉ S₁ := fun hk => hi (Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hk)
   369	            show clExtend f (L₁ (fun j => x (f j))) (f k) = 0
   370	            rw [clExtend_apply hf]
   371	            exact h _ k hk
   372	          · show clExtend f (L₁ (fun j => x (f j))) i = 0
   373	            simp [clExtend, Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ hex])
   374	        (fun y => clReindexTerm hf (rest (fun k => y (f k))))
   375	
   376	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the transported syntax tree is supported on
   377	any register containing the image of the original support. -/
   378	private theorem clReindexTerm_supportedOn {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K]
   379	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι}
   380	    (hf : Function.Injective f) :
   381	    ∀ {ell : ℕ} (t : CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell) (S : Finset κ)
   382	      (T : Finset ι), t.supportedOn S → S.image f ⊆ T →
   383	      (clReindexTerm hf t).supportedOn T := by
   384	  intro ell t
   385	  induction t with
   386	  | zero => intro S T _ _; trivial
   387	  | succ S₁ L₁ hL rest ih =>
   388	      intro S T hsupp hST
   389	      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hsupp
   390	      refine ⟨fun i hi => hST (Finset.image_subset_image h1 hi), fun y => ?_⟩
   391	      refine ih (fun k => y (f k)) (S \ S₁) (T \ S₁.image f) (h2 _) ?_
   392	      intro i hi
   393	      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
   394	      obtain ⟨hkS, hkS₁⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hk
   395	      refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hST (Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hkS), ?_⟩
   396	      intro hmem
   397	      obtain ⟨k', hk', hk'eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
   398	      exact hkS₁ (hf hk'eq ▸ hk')
   399	
   400	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: evaluation commutes with the transport of a
   401	conditionally linear syntax tree along an injective reindexing. -/
   402	private theorem clReindexTerm_eval {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K]
   403	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι}
   404	    (hf : Function.Injective f) :
   405	    ∀ {ell : ℕ} (t : CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell) (x : ι → K),
   406	      CondLinearTerm.eval (clReindexTerm hf t) x =
   407	        clExtend f (CondLinearTerm.eval t (fun k => x (f k))) := by
   408	  intro ell t
   409	  induction t with
   410	  | zero => intro x; exact (clExtend_zero hf).symm
   411	  | succ S₁ L₁ hL rest ih =>
   412	      intro x
   413	      have hres : (fun k => coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x (f k)) =
   414	          coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)) := by
   415	        funext k
   416	        by_cases hk : k ∈ S₁
   417	        · have hmem : f k ∈ S₁.image f := Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hk
   418	          simp [coordinateRestriction, hk, hmem]
   419	        · have hni : f k ∉ S₁.image f := by
   420	            intro hmem

    10	The low-degree question laws have uniform point and coordinate-index marginals,

    29	/-- Select one component of a Pair answer. -/
    30	def selectedPairBit (W : PauliKind) (bits : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) : ZMod 2 :=
    31	  match W with
    32	  | .X => bits.1
    33	  | .Z => bits.2

    35	/-- Winning the commuting Pair/W branch forces equality of the selected bits. -/
    36	theorem pairLabels_eq_of_win (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
    37	    (z : PauliSpace P) (A B : PauliAnswer P)
    38	    (hcomm : IsCommuting (pauliSharedSplit P z).1)
    39	    (hwin : pauliWinPredicate P
    40	      ((.pairW W), pauliCL P (.pairW W) z)
    41	      (.pair, pauliCL P .pair z) A B = true) :
    42	    ProjectiveSetting.pairWAnswerOrZero A =
    43	      selectedPairBit W (ProjectiveSetting.pairAnswerOrZero B) := by
    44	  cases A <;> cases B <;>
    45	    simp [pauliWinPredicate, validPauliAnswer] at hwin
    46	  rename_i bit bits
    47	  simp only [ProjectiveSetting.pairWAnswerOrZero,
    48	    ProjectiveSetting.pairAnswerOrZero]
    49	  have hgamma : pauliPairGamma P (pauliCL P (.pairW W) z) = 0 := by
    50	    change gammaValue P (pauliXBlock z) (pauliZBlock z)
    51	      (pauliRXBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z) = 0 at hcomm
    52	    rw [pauliCL_shared_eq P (.pairW W) rfl]
    53	    change gammaValue P (pauliXBlock z) (pauliZBlock z)
    54	      (pauliRXBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z) = 0
    55	    exact hcomm
    56	  cases W <;>
    57	    simp only [pauliPairCondition, hgamma, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false,
    58	      false_or, selectedPairBit] at hwin ⊢ <;>
    59	    exact hwin.symm

    61	/-- Commuting Pair/W mismatch is contained in rejection. -/
    62	theorem pairMismatch_le_rejection {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    63	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (W : PauliKind) (z : PauliSpace P)
    64	    (hcomm : IsCommuting (pauliSharedSplit P z).1) :
    65	    outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
    66	        ((.pairW W), pauliCL P (.pairW W) z)
    67	        (.pair, pauliCL P .pair z)
    68	        (fun A B => ProjectiveSetting.pairWAnswerOrZero A ≠
    69	          selectedPairBit W (ProjectiveSetting.pairAnswerOrZero B)) ≤
    70	      pauliRejectionAt S.toStrategy
    71	        (pairWPairEdge W) z := by
    72	  apply outcome_event_weight_mono
    73	  intro A B hne
    74	  change pauliWinPredicate P _ _ A B = false
    75	  apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
    76	  intro htrue
    77	  exact hne (pairLabels_eq_of_win P W z A B hcomm htrue)

    79	/-- The commuting consistency defect is the mismatch probability of source answers. -/
    80	theorem commConsistency_eq_mismatch {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    81	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (W : PauliKind) :
    82	    consistencyDefect (commTupleDist P)
    83	        (fun ω a => heteroKron
    84	          ((S.pairWMeas .alice W ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2).effect a) 1)
    85	        (fun ω a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pairComponentMeas .bob W ω).effect a))
    86	        S.toStrategy.ψ =
    87	      avgOver (commTupleDist P) (fun ω =>
    88	        outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
    89	          (ProjectiveSetting.pairWQuestion P W ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2)
    90	          (ProjectiveSetting.pairQuestion P ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2)
    91	          (fun A B => ProjectiveSetting.pairWAnswerOrZero A ≠
    92	            selectedPairBit W (ProjectiveSetting.pairAnswerOrZero B))) := by
    93	  let qA : PauliTuple P → PauliQuestion P := fun ω =>
    94	    ProjectiveSetting.pairWQuestion P W ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2
    95	  let qB : PauliTuple P → PauliQuestion P := fun ω =>
    96	    ProjectiveSetting.pairQuestion P ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2
    97	  let fA : PauliTuple P → PauliAnswer P → ZMod 2 := fun _ =>
    98	    ProjectiveSetting.pairWAnswerOrZero
    99	  let fB : PauliTuple P → PauliAnswer P → ZMod 2 := fun _ B =>
   100	    selectedPairBit W (ProjectiveSetting.pairAnswerOrZero B)
   101	  have h := consistencyDefect_postprocess_eq_mismatch
   102	    (commTupleDist P) S.toStrategy qA qB fA fB
   103	  have hA : ∀ ω c,
   104	      heteroKron ((S.pairWMeas .alice W ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2).effect c)
   105	          (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) =
   106	        heteroKron (((S.toStrategy.A (qA ω)).postprocess (fA ω)).effect c)
   107	          (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
   108	    intro ω c
   109	    rfl
   110	  have hB : ∀ ω c,
   111	      heteroKron (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) ((S.pairComponentMeas .bob W ω).effect c) =
   112	        heteroKron (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA)
   113	          (((S.toStrategy.B (qB ω)).postprocess (fB ω)).effect c) := by
   114	    intro ω c
   115	    congr 1
   116	    unfold ProjectiveSetting.pairComponentMeas ProjectiveSetting.pairMeas fB qB
   117	    rw [measurement_postprocess_comp_effect]
   118	    rfl
   119	  calc
   120	    _ = consistencyDefect (commTupleDist P)
   121	        (fun ω c => heteroKron
   122	          (((S.toStrategy.A (qA ω)).postprocess (fA ω)).effect c) 1)
   123	        (fun ω c => heteroKron 1
   124	          (((S.toStrategy.B (qB ω)).postprocess (fB ω)).effect c))
   125	        S.toStrategy.ψ := consistencyDefect_congr _ _ _ _ _ _ hA hB
   126	    _ = avgOver (commTupleDist P) (fun ω =>
   127	        outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy (qA ω) (qB ω)
   128	          (fun A B => fA ω A ≠ fB ω B)) := h
   129	    _ = _ := by rfl

   131	/-- On commuting tuples, Pair/W answers agree with the corresponding
   132	component of Pair answers. This is item 4 of `lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
   133	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:210-231`, blueprint
   134	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:567-582`. -/
   135	theorem win_comm_proof :
   136	    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧
   137	      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε),
   138	      0 ≤ ε → ∀ W : PauliKind,
   139	      consistencyDefect (commTupleDist P)
   140	        (fun ω a => heteroKron
   141	          ((S.pairWMeas .alice W ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2).effect a) 1)
   142	        (fun ω a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pairComponentMeas .bob W ω).effect a))
   143	        S.toStrategy.ψ ≤ C * ε := by
   144	  refine ⟨2 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ), ?_, ?_⟩
   145	  · have hcard : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card PauliEdge := by
   146	      exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos : 0 < Fintype.card PauliEdge)
   147	    linarith
   148	  intro P ε S _ W
   149	  rw [commConsistency_eq_mismatch]
   150	  calc
   151	    _ ≤ 2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliTuple P)) (fun ω =>
   152	        if IsCommuting ω then
   153	          outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
   154	            (ProjectiveSetting.pairWQuestion P W
   155	              ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2)
   156	            (ProjectiveSetting.pairQuestion P
   157	              ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2)
   158	            (fun A B => ProjectiveSetting.pairWAnswerOrZero A ≠
   159	              selectedPairBit W (ProjectiveSetting.pairAnswerOrZero B))
   160	        else 0) := by
   161	      apply avgOver_comm_le_two_mul_gated
   162	      intro ω
   163	      exact outcome_event_weight_nonneg S.toStrategy _ _ _
   164	    _ ≤ 2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliSpace P))
   165	        (pauliRejectionAt S.toStrategy
   166	          (pairWPairEdge W)) := by
   167	      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by norm_num)
   168	      rw [← avgOver_pauliTuple_uniform]
   169	      apply avgOver_mono
   170	      intro z
   171	      by_cases hcomm : IsCommuting (pauliSharedSplit P z).1
   172	      · simp only [if_pos hcomm]
   173	        have hs := pairMismatch_le_rejection S W z hcomm
   174	        rw [pauliCL_shared_eq P (.pairW W) rfl,
   175	          pauliCL_shared_eq P .pair rfl] at hs
   176	        simpa [pauliSharedSplit, ProjectiveSetting.pairWQuestion,
   177	          ProjectiveSetting.pairQuestion]
   178	          using hs
   179	      · simp only [if_neg hcomm]
   180	        exact pauliRejectionAt_nonneg S.toStrategy _ z
   181	    _ ≤ 2 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * ε := by
   182	      rw [mul_assoc]
   183	      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (fixedEdgeRejection_le_error S _) (by norm_num)

   253	/-- Commuting point-trace/Pair-W mismatch is contained in rejection. -/
   254	theorem pointPairMismatch_le_rejection {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   255	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (W : PauliKind) (z : PauliSpace P)
   256	    (hcomm : IsCommuting (pauliSharedSplit P z).1) :
   257	    outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
   258	        ((.point W), pauliCL P (.point W) z)
   259	        ((.pairW W), pauliCL P (.pairW W) z)
   260	        (fun A B =>
   261	          pointTraceLabel P W (pauliSharedSplit P z).1 A ≠
   262	            ProjectiveSetting.pairWAnswerOrZero B) ≤
   263	      pauliRejectionAt S.toStrategy
   264	        (pointPairWEdge W) z := by
   265	  apply outcome_event_weight_mono
   266	  intro A B hne
   267	  change pauliWinPredicate P _ _ A B = false
   268	  apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
   269	  intro htrue
   270	  exact hne (pointPairLabels_eq_of_win P W z A B hcomm htrue)

   272	/-- Point-trace/Pair-W consistency is the mismatch probability of source answers. -/
   273	theorem commConsConsistency_eq_mismatch {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   274	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (W : PauliKind) :
   275	    consistencyDefect (commTupleDist P)
   276	        (fun ω a => heteroKron
   277	          ((S.pointTraceMeas .alice W (selectedTuplePoint W ω)
   278	            (selectedTupleScalar W ω)).effect a) 1)
   279	        (fun ω a => heteroKron 1
   280	          ((S.pairWMeas .bob W ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2).effect a))
   281	        S.toStrategy.ψ =
   282	      avgOver (commTupleDist P) (fun ω =>
   283	        outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
   284	          (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W (selectedTuplePoint W ω))
   285	          (ProjectiveSetting.pairWQuestion P W
   286	            ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2)
   287	          (fun A B => pointTraceLabel P W ω A ≠
   288	            ProjectiveSetting.pairWAnswerOrZero B)) := by
   289	  let qA : PauliTuple P → PauliQuestion P := fun ω =>
   290	    ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W (selectedTuplePoint W ω)
   291	  let qB : PauliTuple P → PauliQuestion P := fun ω =>
   292	    ProjectiveSetting.pairWQuestion P W ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2
   293	  let fA : PauliTuple P → PauliAnswer P → ZMod 2 := fun ω A =>
   294	    pointTraceLabel P W ω A
   295	  let fB : PauliTuple P → PauliAnswer P → ZMod 2 := fun _ =>
   296	    ProjectiveSetting.pairWAnswerOrZero
   297	  have h := consistencyDefect_postprocess_eq_mismatch
   298	    (commTupleDist P) S.toStrategy qA qB fA fB
   299	  have hA : ∀ ω c,
   300	      heteroKron
   301	          ((S.pointTraceMeas .alice W (selectedTuplePoint W ω)
   302	            (selectedTupleScalar W ω)).effect c)
   303	          (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) =
   304	        heteroKron (((S.toStrategy.A (qA ω)).postprocess (fA ω)).effect c)
   305	          (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
   306	    intro ω c
   307	    congr 1
   308	    unfold ProjectiveSetting.pointTraceMeas ProjectiveSetting.pointMeas fA
   309	    rw [measurement_postprocess_comp_effect]
   310	    rfl
   311	  have hB : ∀ ω c,
   312	      heteroKron (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA)
   313	          ((S.pairWMeas .bob W ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2).effect c) =
   314	        heteroKron (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA)
   315	          (((S.toStrategy.B (qB ω)).postprocess (fB ω)).effect c) := by
   316	    intro ω c
   317	    rfl
   318	  calc
   319	    _ = consistencyDefect (commTupleDist P)
   320	        (fun ω c => heteroKron
   321	          (((S.toStrategy.A (qA ω)).postprocess (fA ω)).effect c) 1)
   322	        (fun ω c => heteroKron 1
   323	          (((S.toStrategy.B (qB ω)).postprocess (fB ω)).effect c))
   324	        S.toStrategy.ψ := consistencyDefect_congr _ _ _ _ _ _ hA hB
   325	    _ = avgOver (commTupleDist P) (fun ω =>
   326	        outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy (qA ω) (qB ω)
   327	          (fun A B => fA ω A ≠ fB ω B)) := h
   328	    _ = _ := by rfl
   329	
   330	/-- On commuting tuples, trace-coarse-grained point answers agree with Pair/W
   331	answers. This is item 5 of `lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
   332	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:232-239`, blueprint
   333	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:583-598`. -/
   334	theorem win_comm_cons_proof :
   335	    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧
   336	      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε),
   337	      0 ≤ ε → ∀ W : PauliKind,
   338	      consistencyDefect (commTupleDist P)
   339	        (fun ω a => heteroKron
   340	          ((S.pointTraceMeas .alice W
   341	            (match W with | .X => ω.1 | .Z => ω.2.1)
   342	            (match W with | .X => ω.2.2.1 | .Z => ω.2.2.2)).effect a) 1)
   343	        (fun ω a => heteroKron 1
   344	          ((S.pairWMeas .bob W ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2).effect a))
   345	        S.toStrategy.ψ ≤ C * ε := by
   346	  refine ⟨2 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ), ?_, ?_⟩
   347	  · have hcard : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card PauliEdge := by
   348	      exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos : 0 < Fintype.card PauliEdge)
   349	    linarith
   350	  intro P ε S _ W
   351	  change consistencyDefect (commTupleDist P)
   352	      (fun ω a => heteroKron
   353	        ((S.pointTraceMeas .alice W (selectedTuplePoint W ω)
   354	          (selectedTupleScalar W ω)).effect a) 1)
   355	      (fun ω a => heteroKron 1
   356	        ((S.pairWMeas .bob W ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2).effect a))
   357	      S.toStrategy.ψ ≤ _
   358	  rw [commConsConsistency_eq_mismatch]
   359	  calc
   360	    _ ≤ 2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliTuple P)) (fun ω =>
   361	        if IsCommuting ω then
   362	          outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
   363	            (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W (selectedTuplePoint W ω))
   364	            (ProjectiveSetting.pairWQuestion P W
   365	              ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2)
   366	            (fun A B => pointTraceLabel P W ω A ≠
   367	              ProjectiveSetting.pairWAnswerOrZero B)
   368	        else 0) := by
   369	      apply avgOver_comm_le_two_mul_gated
   370	      intro ω
   371	      exact outcome_event_weight_nonneg S.toStrategy _ _ _
   372	    _ ≤ 2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliSpace P))
   373	        (pauliRejectionAt S.toStrategy
   374	          (pointPairWEdge W)) := by
   375	      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by norm_num)
   376	      rw [← avgOver_pauliTuple_uniform]
   377	      apply avgOver_mono
   378	      intro z
   379	      by_cases hcomm : IsCommuting (pauliSharedSplit P z).1
   380	      · simp only [if_pos hcomm]
   381	        have hs := pointPairMismatch_le_rejection S W z hcomm
   382	        rw [pauliCL_point_eq,
   383	          pauliCL_shared_eq P (.pairW W) rfl] at hs
   384	        rw [pauliToLd_point_eq_selected] at hs
   385	        simpa [pauliSharedSplit, selectedTuplePoint,
   386	          ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion, ProjectiveSetting.pairWQuestion]
   387	          using hs
   388	      · simp only [if_neg hcomm]
   389	        exact pauliRejectionAt_nonneg S.toStrategy _ z
   390	    _ ≤ 2 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * ε := by
   391	      rw [mul_assoc]
   392	      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (fixedEdgeRejection_le_error S _) (by norm_num)

    64	theorem applyOperatorToState_reindexState_ofLp {ι κ : Type*}

     3	/-!
     4	# Exact consistency winning implication
     5	
     6	This module proves the exact same-question consistency bound for the two
     7	players' Pauli-test measurements.
     8	
     9	## References
    10	
    11	The proof infrastructure in this module supports `lem:qld-win-implications`
    12	from `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:192-267`
    13	and `blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:505-660`.
    14	-/
    15	
    16	open scoped BigOperators Matrix ComplexOrder
    17	
    18	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    19	
    20	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    21	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    22	
    23	noncomputable section
    24	
    25	namespace WinImplications
    26	
    27	local instance pauliEdgeNonemptyConsistency : Nonempty PauliEdge := pauliEdge_nonempty
    28	
    29	/-- The self-loop verifier edge at one Pauli question type. -/
    30	def pauliLoopEdge (t : PauliType) : PauliEdge :=
    31	  ⟨(t, t), by simp [pauliEdges]⟩
    32	
    33	/-- Answer-mismatch mass at the first question generated by one sampler edge. -/
    34	noncomputable def firstQuestionMismatch {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    35	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (e : PauliEdge) (z : PauliSpace P) : ℝ :=
    36	  outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
    37	    (e.1.1, pauliCL P e.1.1 z) (e.1.1, pauliCL P e.1.1 z)
    38	    (fun A B => A ≠ B)
    39	
    40	/-- Unequal answers to the same sampled question are rejected on its self-loop. -/
    41	theorem loopMismatch_le_rejection {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    42	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (t : PauliType) (z : PauliSpace P) :
    43	    outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
    44	        (t, pauliCL P t z) (t, pauliCL P t z) (fun A B => A ≠ B) ≤
    45	      pauliRejectionAt S.toStrategy (pauliLoopEdge t) z := by
    46	  unfold pauliRejectionAt pauliSourceQuestions pauliLoopEdge
    47	  dsimp
    48	  apply outcome_event_weight_mono
    49	  intro A B hne
    50	  simp only [pauliBasisTest]
    51	  simp only [pauliWinPredicate, Bool.and_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
    52	    Bool.if_false_right, Bool.decide_and, Bool.decide_eq_true,
    53	    Bool.and_eq_false_imp, decide_eq_false_iff_not, and_imp]
    54	  intro _ _
    55	  exact hne
    56	
    57	/-- Strategy consistency is the same-question answer-mismatch probability. -/
    58	theorem strategyConsistency_eq_mismatch {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    59	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
    60	    consistencyDefect (pauliQuestionMarginal P)
    61	        (fun question a => heteroKron
    62	          ((S.strategyMeasurement .alice question).effect a) 1)
    63	        (fun question a => heteroKron 1
    64	          ((S.strategyMeasurement .bob question).effect a))
    65	        S.toStrategy.ψ =
    66	      avgOver (pauliQuestionMarginal P) (fun question =>
    67	        outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy question question (fun A B => A ≠ B)) := by
    68	  change consistencyDefect (pauliQuestionMarginal P)
    69	      (fun question a => heteroKron ((S.toStrategy.A question).effect a)
    70	        (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB))
    71	      (fun question a => heteroKron (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA)
    72	        ((S.toStrategy.B question).effect a))
    73	      S.toStrategy.ψ = _
    74	  unfold consistencyDefect outcomeEventWeight
    75	  apply avgOver_congr
    76	  intro question
    77	  simp only [DistanceCalculus.consistency_term_eq_stateQForm]
    78	  simp_rw [DistanceCalculus.placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
    79	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    80	  intro A _
    81	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    82	  intro B _
    83	  by_cases hAB : A = B
    84	  · simp [hAB]
    85	  · simp [hAB, DistanceCalculus.stateQForm, outcomeWeight,
    86	      applyOperatorToState]
    87	
    88	/-- The consistency subtest bounds the off-diagonal defect of the two strategy
    89	measurement families. This is item 1 of `lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
    90	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:197-199`, blueprint
    91	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:515-522`. -/
    92	theorem win_cons_proof :
    93	    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧
    94	      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε),
    95	      0 ≤ ε →
    96	      consistencyDefect (pauliQuestionMarginal P)
    97	        (fun question a => heteroKron
    98	          ((S.strategyMeasurement .alice question).effect a) 1)
    99	        (fun question a => heteroKron 1
   100	          ((S.strategyMeasurement .bob question).effect a))
   101	        S.toStrategy.ψ ≤ C * ε := by
   102	  refine ⟨(Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ), ?_, ?_⟩
   103	  · exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos : 0 < Fintype.card PauliEdge)
   104	  intro P ε S _
   105	  rw [strategyConsistency_eq_mismatch]
   106	  unfold pauliQuestionMarginal pauliQuestionDistribution
   107	  rw [Distribution.avgOver_map, Distribution.avgOver_map]
   108	  change avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliEdge × PauliSpace P))
   109	      (fun ez => firstQuestionMismatch S ez.1 ez.2) ≤ _
   110	  rw [avgOver_uniform_prod]
   111	  calc
   112	    avgOver (uniformDistribution PauliEdge) (fun e =>
   113	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliSpace P)) (fun z =>
   114	          firstQuestionMismatch S e z)) ≤
   115	      avgOver (uniformDistribution PauliEdge)
   116	        (fun _ => (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * ε) := by
   117	      apply avgOver_mono
   118	      intro e
   119	      calc
   120	        _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliSpace P))
   121	            (pauliRejectionAt S.toStrategy (pauliLoopEdge e.1.1)) := by
   122	          apply avgOver_mono
   123	          intro z
   124	          exact loopMismatch_le_rejection S e.1.1 z
   125	        _ ≤ (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * ε :=
   126	          fixedEdgeRejection_le_error S _
   127	    _ = (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * ε := by
   128	      exact avgOver_const_of_isProbability _
   129	        (uniformDistribution_isProbability PauliEdge) _
   130	
   131	
   132	end WinImplications
   133	
   134	end
   135	
   136	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

    28	/-- Coordinates outside one low-degree register in the Pauli seed. -/
    29	abbrev PauliLdRemainder (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
    30	  (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P
    31	
    32	/-- Split a Pauli seed into a basis-selected low-degree seed and unused coordinates. -/
    33	def pauliLdSplit (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind) :
    34	    PauliSpace P ≃ LdSpace P.toLdParams × PauliLdRemainder P where
    35	  toFun z :=
    36	    (pauliToLd P W z,
    37	      (match W with | .X => pauliZBlock z | .Z => pauliXBlock z,
    38	        pauliRXBlock z, pauliRZBlock z))
    39	  invFun zr := fun i =>
    40	    match i with
    41	    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inl j)))) =>
    42	        match W with
    43	        | .X => zr.1 (.inl (.inl j))
    44	        | .Z => zr.2.1 j
    45	    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inr j)))) =>
    46	        match W with
    47	        | .X => zr.2.1 j
    48	        | .Z => zr.1 (.inl (.inl j))
    49	    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inr _))) => zr.1 (.inl (.inr ()))
    50	    | .inl (.inl (.inr j)) => zr.1 (.inr j)
    51	    | .inl (.inr _) => zr.2.2.1
    52	    | .inr _ => zr.2.2.2
    53	  left_inv z := by
    54	    funext i
    55	    rcases i with ((((j | j) | u) | j) | u) | u <;> cases W <;> rfl
    56	  right_inv zr := by
    57	    rcases zr with ⟨z, other, rX, rZ⟩
    58	    apply Prod.ext
    59	    · funext i
    60	      rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> cases W <;> rfl
    61	    · cases W <;> rfl
    62	
    63	/-- Coordinates discarded by the shared Pair and Magic Square projection. -/
    64	abbrev PauliSharedRemainder (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
    65	  PauliScalar P × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    66	
    67	/-- Split a Pauli seed into its shared tuple and discarded scalar/direction blocks. -/
    68	def pauliSharedSplit (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    69	    PauliSpace P ≃ PauliTuple P × PauliSharedRemainder P where
    70	  toFun z :=
    71	    ((pauliXBlock z, pauliZBlock z, pauliRXBlock z, pauliRZBlock z),
    72	      pauliScalarBlock z, pauliDirectionBlock z)
    73	  invFun zr := fun i =>
    74	    match i with
    75	    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inl j)))) => zr.1.1 j
    76	    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inr j)))) => zr.1.2.1 j
    77	    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inr _))) => zr.2.1
    78	    | .inl (.inl (.inr j)) => zr.2.2 j
    79	    | .inl (.inr _) => zr.1.2.2.1
    80	    | .inr _ => zr.1.2.2.2
    81	  left_inv z := by
    82	    funext i
    83	    rcases i with ((((j | j) | u) | j) | u) | u <;> rfl
    84	  right_inv zr := by
    85	    rcases zr with ⟨⟨uX, uZ, rX, rZ⟩, scalar, direction⟩
    86	    rfl

    88	/-- Split a low-degree seed into its point and unused scalar/direction blocks. -/
    89	def ldPointSplit (L : LdParams) :
    90	    LdSpace L ≃ (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) × (ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)) where
    91	  toFun z := (z.point, z.seed, z.direction)
    92	  invFun zr := fun i =>
    93	    match i with
    94	    | .inl (.inl j) => zr.1 j

    96	    | .inr j => zr.2.2 j

   104	/-- Uniform Pauli seeds have the uniform low-degree marginal in either basis. -/

    53	/--
    54	The marginal of a joint POVM obtained by post-processing its answer pair.  This

    56	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:8-26`; the post-processing operation

    60	noncomputable def marginalLeft {α β d : Type*}
    61	    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    62	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]

    66	/-- The right marginal of a joint POVM, obtained using `Prod.snd` in

    72	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    73	    (M : Measurement (α × β) d) : Measurement β d :=

    88	structure Strategy (G : Game) where
    89	  ιA : Type
    90	  ιB : Type
    91	  [ιAFintype : Fintype ιA]
    92	  [ιBFintype : Fintype ιB]
    93	  [ιADecidableEq : DecidableEq ιA]
    94	  [ιBDecidableEq : DecidableEq ιB]
    95	  ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)

   103	/-- The rectangular tensor placement used in strategy probabilities.  This is
   104	the finite-matrix realization of `def:tensor-product-strategy`, blueprint
   105	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`; paper origin
   106	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`.
   107	-/
   108	def heteroKron {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (B : Op ιB) : Op (ιA × ιB) :=
   109	  Matrix.kronecker A B
   110	
   111	/-! ### Algebra of the tensor placement
   112	
   113	The shared tensor-placement API.  These identities are used both by the perfect
   114	Magic Square strategy (`thm:ms-from-ac`, blueprint
   115	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:257-267`) and by the rigidity transfer
   116	step (`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`), so they live
   117	with the definition rather than in either development. -/
   118	
   119	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
   120	(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`, paper
   121	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`): the tensor
   122	placement is multiplicative, `(A ⊗ C) * (B ⊗ D) = (A * B) ⊗ (C * D)`. -/
   123	theorem heteroKron_mul {ιA ιB : Type*} [Fintype ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   124	    (A B : Op ιA) (C D : Op ιB) :
   125	    heteroKron A C * heteroKron B D = heteroKron (A * B) (C * D) := by
   126	  unfold heteroKron Matrix.kronecker
   127	  exact (Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul A B C D).symm
   128	
   129	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
   130	(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`): the tensor
   131	placement of the two identity operators is the identity operator on the product
   132	space. -/
   133	theorem heteroKron_one_one {ιA ιB : Type*} [DecidableEq ιA] [DecidableEq ιB] :
   134	    heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (1 : Op ιB) = 1 := by
   135	  unfold heteroKron Matrix.kronecker
   136	  exact Matrix.one_kronecker_one
   137	
   138	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
   139	(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`): tensor placement
   140	respects negation in the left factor. -/
   141	theorem heteroKron_neg_left {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (C : Op ιB) :
   142	    heteroKron (-A) C = -heteroKron A C := by
   143	  ext p q
   144	  simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker]
   145	
   146	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
   147	(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`): tensor placement
   148	respects negation in the right factor. -/
   149	theorem heteroKron_neg_right {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (C : Op ιB) :
   150	    heteroKron A (-C) = -heteroKron A C := by
   151	  ext p q
   152	  simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker]
   153	
   154	/- The Euclidean linear map is the shared action used by the value and distance
   155	functionals.  Keeping it at the Euclidean-space level avoids accidentally
   156	using the function-space supremum norm of `Matrix.mulVec`. -/
   157	/-- Apply a finite matrix to a Euclidean-space state.  This is the Hilbert-space
   158	action underlying `def:tensor-product-value`, paper
   159	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:219-271`. -/
   160	noncomputable def applyOperatorToState {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   161	    (M : Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι :=
   162	  Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ

   164	/-- The Born weight of an answer pair for a strategy.  Lean-only support for
   165	`def:tensor-product-value`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:71-82`, paper
   166	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-48`. -/
   167	noncomputable def outcomeWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   168	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (a : G.AnswerA) (b : G.AnswerB) : ℝ :=
   169	  let M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
   170	    heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)
   171	  let acted := applyOperatorToState M S.ψ
   172	  (inner ℂ S.ψ acted).re
   173	
   174	/-- Alice's marginal Born weight for an answer at a fixed question. -/
   175	noncomputable def aliceOutcomeWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   176	    (x : G.QuestionA) (a : G.AnswerA) : ℝ :=
   177	  let M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
   178	    heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) 1
   179	  (inner ℂ S.ψ (applyOperatorToState M S.ψ)).re
   180	
   181	/-- Bob's marginal Born weight for an answer at a fixed question. -/
   182	noncomputable def bobOutcomeWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   183	    (y : G.QuestionB) (b : G.AnswerB) : ℝ :=
   184	  let M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
   185	    heteroKron 1 ((S.B y).effect b)
   186	  (inner ℂ S.ψ (applyOperatorToState M S.ψ)).re
   187	
   188	/-- The Born weight of a decidable event on the two answers at fixed questions. -/
   189	noncomputable def outcomeEventWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   190	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB)
   191	    (E : G.AnswerA → G.AnswerB → Prop) [DecidableRel E] : ℝ :=
   192	  ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   193	    if E a b then outcomeWeight S x y a b else 0
   194	
   195	/-- The marginal Born weight of a decidable event on Alice's answer. -/
   196	noncomputable def aliceEventWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   197	    (x : G.QuestionA) (E : G.AnswerA → Prop) [DecidablePred E] : ℝ :=
   198	  ∑ a : G.AnswerA, if E a then aliceOutcomeWeight S x a else 0
   199	
   200	/-- The marginal Born weight of a decidable event on Bob's answer. -/
   201	noncomputable def bobEventWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   202	    (y : G.QuestionB) (E : G.AnswerB → Prop) [DecidablePred E] : ℝ :=
   203	  ∑ b : G.AnswerB, if E b then bobOutcomeWeight S y b else 0

   205	/-- Every answer-pair Born weight is nonnegative.  This is formalization-only
   206	support for the probability expression in `def:tensor-product-value`. -/
   207	theorem outcomeWeight_nonneg {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   208	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (a : G.AnswerA) (b : G.AnswerB) :
   209	    0 ≤ outcomeWeight S x y a b := by
   210	  unfold outcomeWeight applyOperatorToState heteroKron
   211	  exact
   212	    (Matrix.isPositive_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr
   213	      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
   214	        (kronecker_nonneg ((S.A x).pos a) ((S.B y).pos b)))).re_inner_nonneg_right S.ψ
   215	
   216	/-- The Born weights of all answer pairs at fixed questions sum to one.  This
   217	is formalization-only support for the POVM normalization implicit in
   218	`def:tensor-product-value`. -/
   219	theorem outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   220	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) :
   221	    ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB, outcomeWeight S x y a b = 1 := by
   222	  have hsum :
   223	      (∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   224	        heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) =
   225	          (1 : Op (S.ιA × S.ιB)) := by
   226	    ext i j
   227	    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   228	      Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
   229	    simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
   230	    rw [show (∑ a : G.AnswerA, (S.A x).effect a i.1 j.1) =
   231	        (1 : Op S.ιA) i.1 j.1 by
   232	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun (S.A x).sum_eq_one i.1) j.1]
   233	    rw [show (∑ b : G.AnswerB, (S.B y).effect b i.2 j.2) =
   234	        (1 : Op S.ιB) i.2 j.2 by
   235	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun (S.B y).sum_eq_one i.2) j.2]
   236	    exact congrFun (congrFun
   237	      (Matrix.one_kronecker_one (m := S.ιA) (n := S.ιB) (α := ℂ)) i) j
   238	  calc
   239	    ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB, outcomeWeight S x y a b =
   240	        (inner ℂ S.ψ
   241	          (applyOperatorToState
   242	            (∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   243	              heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re := by
   244	          simp [outcomeWeight, applyOperatorToState]
   245	    _ = (inner ℂ S.ψ (applyOperatorToState 1 S.ψ)).re := by rw [hsum]
   246	    _ = 1 := by
   247	      simp [applyOperatorToState, S.ψ_norm]

   249	/-- Summing over Bob's answers gives Alice's marginal Born weight. -/
   250	theorem sum_outcome_weight_right {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   251	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (a : G.AnswerA) :
   252	    (∑ b : G.AnswerB, outcomeWeight S x y a b) = aliceOutcomeWeight S x a := by
   253	  have hsum :
   254	      (∑ b : G.AnswerB, heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) =
   255	        heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) 1 := by
   256	    ext i j
   257	    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   258	      Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
   259	    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
   260	    rw [show (∑ b : G.AnswerB, (S.B y).effect b i.2 j.2) =
   261	        (1 : Op S.ιB) i.2 j.2 by
   262	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun (S.B y).sum_eq_one i.2) j.2]
   263	  calc
   264	    (∑ b : G.AnswerB, outcomeWeight S x y a b) =
   265	        (inner ℂ S.ψ
   266	          (applyOperatorToState
   267	            (∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   268	              heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re := by
   269	          simp [outcomeWeight, applyOperatorToState]
   270	    _ = (inner ℂ S.ψ
   271	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) 1) S.ψ)).re := by
   272	      rw [hsum]
   273	    _ = aliceOutcomeWeight S x a := rfl

   275	/-- Summing over Alice's answers gives Bob's marginal Born weight. -/
   276	theorem sum_outcome_weight_left {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   277	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (b : G.AnswerB) :
   278	    (∑ a : G.AnswerA, outcomeWeight S x y a b) = bobOutcomeWeight S y b := by
   279	  have hsum :
   280	      (∑ a : G.AnswerA, heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) =
   281	        heteroKron 1 ((S.B y).effect b) := by
   282	    ext i j
   283	    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   284	      Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
   285	    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
   286	    rw [show (∑ a : G.AnswerA, (S.A x).effect a i.1 j.1) =
   287	        (1 : Op S.ιA) i.1 j.1 by
   288	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun (S.A x).sum_eq_one i.1) j.1]
   289	  calc
   290	    (∑ a : G.AnswerA, outcomeWeight S x y a b) =
   291	        (inner ℂ S.ψ
   292	          (applyOperatorToState
   293	            (∑ a : G.AnswerA,
   294	              heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re := by
   295	          simp [outcomeWeight, applyOperatorToState]
   296	    _ = (inner ℂ S.ψ
   297	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((S.B y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re := by
   298	      rw [hsum]

   301	/-- Every answer event has nonnegative Born weight. -/
   302	theorem outcome_event_weight_nonneg {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   303	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB)
   304	    (E : G.AnswerA → G.AnswerB → Prop) [DecidableRel E] :
   305	    0 ≤ outcomeEventWeight S x y E := by
   306	  unfold outcomeEventWeight
   307	  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => by
   308	    split_ifs
   309	    · exact outcomeWeight_nonneg S x y a b
   310	    · exact le_rfl

   312	/-- An answer event depending only on Alice has its Alice marginal weight. -/
   313	theorem outcome_event_weight_left_eq {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   314	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB)
   315	    (E : G.AnswerA → Prop) [DecidablePred E] :
   316	    outcomeEventWeight S x y (fun a _ => E a) = aliceEventWeight S x E := by
   317	  unfold outcomeEventWeight aliceEventWeight

400	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: evaluation commutes with the transport of a
   401	conditionally linear syntax tree along an injective reindexing. -/
   402	private theorem clReindexTerm_eval {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K]
   403	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι}
   404	    (hf : Function.Injective f) :
   405	    ∀ {ell : ℕ} (t : CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell) (x : ι → K),
   406	      CondLinearTerm.eval (clReindexTerm hf t) x =
   407	        clExtend f (CondLinearTerm.eval t (fun k => x (f k))) := by
   408	  intro ell t
   409	  induction t with
   410	  | zero => intro x; exact (clExtend_zero hf).symm
   411	  | succ S₁ L₁ hL rest ih =>
   412	      intro x
   413	      have hres : (fun k => coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x (f k)) =
   414	          coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)) := by
   415	        funext k
   416	        by_cases hk : k ∈ S₁
   417	        · have hmem : f k ∈ S₁.image f := Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hk
   418	          simp [coordinateRestriction, hk, hmem]
   419	        · have hni : f k ∉ S₁.image f := by
   420	            intro hmem
   421	            obtain ⟨k', hk', hk'eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
   422	            exact hk (hf hk'eq ▸ hk')
   423	          simp [coordinateRestriction, hk, hni]
   424	      have hhead : clReindexLinear hf L₁ (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) =
   425	          clExtend f (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)))) := by
   426	        show clExtend f (L₁ (fun k => coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x (f k))) = _
   427	        rw [hres]
   428	      have hcomp : (fun k => clReindexLinear hf L₁
   429	            (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) (f k)) =
   430	          L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k))) := by
   431	        rw [hhead]
   432	        exact clExtend_comp hf _
   433	      show clReindexLinear hf L₁ (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) +
   434	          CondLinearTerm.eval (clReindexTerm hf (rest
   435	            (fun k => clReindexLinear hf L₁
   436	              (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) (f k)))) x =
   437	        clExtend f (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k))) +
   438	          CondLinearTerm.eval
   439	            (rest (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)))))
   440	            (fun k => x (f k)))
   441	      rw [hcomp, ih _ x, hhead, ← clExtend_add hf]

   608	/-- A finite edge set for the typed Pauli question graph.  The self-loops and

   610	`def:pauli-question-distribution`, blueprint lines 285-329, paper origin

   613	def pauliEdges : Finset (Sym2 PauliType) :=
   614	  let loops := Finset.univ.image (fun t : PauliType => Sym2.mk t t)
   615	  let lineEdges :=
   616	    (Finset.univ : Finset PauliKind).image (fun W =>
   617	      Sym2.mk (.point W) (.aline W)) ∪
   618	      (Finset.univ : Finset PauliKind).image (fun W =>
   619	        Sym2.mk (.point W) (.dline W)) ∪
   620	      (Finset.univ : Finset PauliKind).image (fun W =>
   621	        Sym2.mk (.point W) (.pauli W))
   622	  let basisEdges :=
   623	    (Finset.univ : Finset PauliKind).image (fun W =>
   624	      Sym2.mk (.point W) (.pairW W)) ∪
   625	      ({Sym2.mk (.point .X) (.ms (.var ⟨0, by decide⟩)),
   626	        Sym2.mk (.point .Z) (.ms (.var ⟨4, by decide⟩))} : Finset (Sym2 PauliType))
   627	  let pairEdges :=
   628	    (Finset.univ : Finset PauliKind).image (fun W =>
   629	      Sym2.mk (.pairW W) .pair)
   630	  let msEdges' :=
   631	    (Finset.univ : Finset (MsType × MsType)).filter (fun xy =>
   632	      Sym2.mk xy.1 xy.2 ∈ msEdges) |>.image (fun xy =>
   633	        Sym2.mk (.ms xy.1) (.ms xy.2))
   634	  loops ∪ lineEdges ∪ basisEdges ∪ pairEdges ∪ msEdges'

+/-- Restrict a multivariate polynomial to an axis-parallel line, retaining the
+coefficients through degree `d`.  This is the degree-`d` answer used for the
+axis-line clause of `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
