+noncomputable def restrictToAxisLine (L : LdParams) (line : LineDesc L)
+    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin L.m) (ScalarQ L)) : DegPoly L L.d :=
+  fun i => (polynomialOnLine L line g).coeff i.val
+
+/-- The coefficient-list restriction to an axis line evaluates to the original
+low-degree encoding at every point of that line. -/
+theorem evalCoefficient_restrictToAxisLine_lowDegreeEncoding
+    (L : LdParams) (line : LineDesc L) (hline : line.kind = .axis)
+    (h : Cube L.m → ScalarQ L) (t : ScalarQ L) :
+    evalCoefficient (restrictToAxisLine L line (lowDegreeEncoding h)) t =
+      MvPolynomial.eval (line.base + t • line.direction) (lowDegreeEncoding h) := by
+  calc
+    evalCoefficient (restrictToAxisLine L line (lowDegreeEncoding h)) t =
+        Polynomial.eval t (polynomialOnLine L line (lowDegreeEncoding h)) := by
+      unfold evalCoefficient restrictToAxisLine
+      rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range'
+        (Nat.lt_succ_of_le

+            L line hline h).trans L.hd)) t]
+      exact Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range

theorem pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute (P : AdmissibleParams)
    (z : PauliSpace P) (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) (a b : ZMod 2) :
    Commute ((pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a)
      ((pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b) := by
  have hOO :
      Commute (tauObservable PauliKind.X (pauliRXBlock z • indicatorVec (pauliXBlock z)))
        (tauObservable PauliKind.Z (pauliRZBlock z • indicatorVec (pauliZBlock z))) := by
    rw [← obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z),
      ← obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)]
    exact obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_commute P z hgamma

    pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_eq_reflectionEffect]

/-- The Pair effect `E^{Pair,ω}_{β_X, β_Z} = A_{β_X} B_{β_Z}` of Equation
`eq:pair-definition`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1339`. -/
noncomputable def pauliPairEffect (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
    (β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) : Op (PauliRegister P) :=
  (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect β.1 *
    (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect β.2

/-- For `γ = 0` the Pair effects are projectors, being products of commuting
projectors.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1344`. -/
theorem pauliPairEffect_isProj (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) (β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) :
    IsProj (pauliPairEffect P z β) :=
  IsStarProjection.mul (pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .X _ _ β.1)
    (pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .Z _ _ β.2)
    (pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute P z hgamma β.1 β.2)

/-- The Pair effects sum to the identity. -/
theorem sum_pauliPairEffect (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P) :
    ∑ β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, pauliPairEffect P z β = 1 := by
  calc ∑ β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, pauliPairEffect P z β
      = ∑ a : ZMod 2, ∑ b : ZMod 2,
          (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a *
            (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b :=
        Fintype.sum_prod_type _
    _ = ∑ a : ZMod 2,
          (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a *
            ∑ b : ZMod 2,
              (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = 1 := by
        rw [(pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).sum_eq_one]
        simp [(pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).sum_eq_one]

/-- The Pair measurement of Equation `eq:pair-definition` in the case `γ = 0`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1344`,
blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:390-395`. -/
noncomputable def pauliPairMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) : Measurement (ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) (PauliRegister P) :=
  Measurement.ofSumEqOne (pauliPairEffect P z)
    (fun β => (pauliPairEffect_isProj P z hgamma β).nonneg) (sum_pauliPairEffect P z)

/-- The Pair measurement is projective. -/
theorem pauliPairMeasurement_projective (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) :
    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (pauliPairMeasurement P z hgamma) :=
  pauliPairEffect_isProj P z hgamma

/-- The Pair measurement is consistent on the EPR state.  This is the
consistency assertion for the Pair measurement in the case `γ = 0`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1368-1372`. -/
theorem pauliPairMeasurement_isConsistentOn (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) :
    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsConsistentOn (pauliPairMeasurement P z hgamma)
      (eprState (PauliRegister P)) := by
  intro β
  refine epr_action_eq_of_transpose _ ?_

  rw [pauliPairEffect, Matrix.transpose_mul, pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose,
    pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose]

/-- For `γ = 0` the Pair effects are projectors, being products of commuting
projectors.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1344`. -/
theorem pauliPairEffect_isProj (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) (β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) :
    IsProj (pauliPairEffect P z β) :=
  IsStarProjection.mul (pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .X _ _ β.1)
    (pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .Z _ _ β.2)
    (pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute P z hgamma β.1 β.2)

/-- The Pair effects sum to the identity. -/
theorem sum_pauliPairEffect (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P) :
    ∑ β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, pauliPairEffect P z β = 1 := by
  calc ∑ β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, pauliPairEffect P z β
      = ∑ a : ZMod 2, ∑ b : ZMod 2,
          (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a *
            (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b :=
        Fintype.sum_prod_type _
    _ = ∑ a : ZMod 2,
          (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a *
            ∑ b : ZMod 2,
              (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = 1 := by
        rw [(pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).sum_eq_one]
        simp [(pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).sum_eq_one]

/-- The Pair measurement of Equation `eq:pair-definition` in the case `γ = 0`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1344`,
blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:390-395`. -/
noncomputable def pauliPairMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) : Measurement (ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) (PauliRegister P) :=
  Measurement.ofSumEqOne (pauliPairEffect P z)
    (fun β => (pauliPairEffect_isProj P z hgamma β).nonneg) (sum_pauliPairEffect P z)

/-- The Pair measurement is projective. -/
theorem pauliPairMeasurement_projective (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) :
    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (pauliPairMeasurement P z hgamma) :=
  pauliPairEffect_isProj P z hgamma

/-- The Pair measurement is consistent on the EPR state.  This is the
consistency assertion for the Pair measurement in the case `γ = 0`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1368-1372`. -/
theorem pauliPairMeasurement_isConsistentOn (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) :
    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsConsistentOn (pauliPairMeasurement P z hgamma)
      (eprState (PauliRegister P)) := by
  intro β
  refine epr_action_eq_of_transpose _ ?_
  change (pauliPairEffect P z β)ᵀ = pauliPairEffect P z β
  rw [pauliPairEffect, Matrix.transpose_mul, pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose,
    pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose]
  exact (pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute P z hgamma β.1 β.2).eq.symm

end

     3	/-!
     4	# Commuting and anticommuting Pauli tuples
     5	
     6	This module defines the tuple phase used in the Pauli basis test and the
     7	conditional uniform distributions used by its observable analysis.
     8	
     9	## References
    10	
    11	The definitions and probability bounds formalize `def:anticommuting-tuple`
    12	and `fact:omega-anticomm-prob` in
    13	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:128-267`, with paper origin
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:64-95`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    18	
    19	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    20	
    21	noncomputable section
    22	
    23	/-- A tuple `(u_X,u_Z,r_X,r_Z)` over the fixed field model of an admissible
    24	Pauli-test parameter tuple. This is the tuple space of
    25	`def:anticommuting-tuple`, blueprint `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:128-148`, paper
    26	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:64-68`. -/
    27	abbrev PauliTuple (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
    28	  (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) ×
    29	    (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P
    30	
    31	/-- A Pauli tuple is anticommuting when its phase bit is nonzero. This is
    32	`def:anticommuting-tuple`, blueprint `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:128-148`, paper
    33	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:64-68`. -/
    34	def IsAnticommuting {P : AdmissibleParams} (ω : PauliTuple P) : Prop :=
    35	  gammaValue P ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2 ≠ 0
    36	
    37	/-- A Pauli tuple is commuting when its phase bit vanishes. This is the
    38	complementary case in `def:anticommuting-tuple`, blueprint
    39	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:128-148`, paper
    40	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:64-68`. -/
    41	def IsCommuting {P : AdmissibleParams} (ω : PauliTuple P) : Prop :=
    42	  gammaValue P ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2 = 0
    43	
    44	noncomputable instance (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    45	    DecidablePred (@IsAnticommuting P) := Classical.decPred _
    46	
    47	noncomputable instance (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    48	    DecidablePred (@IsCommuting P) := Classical.decPred _
    49	
    50	/-- The uniform probability of the anticommuting event. This is the first
    51	quantity in `fact:omega-anticomm-prob`, blueprint
    52	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-178`, paper
    53	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:70-77`. -/
    54	noncomputable def anticommProb (P : AdmissibleParams) : ℝ :=
    55	  ((Finset.univ.filter (@IsAnticommuting P)).card : ℝ) /
    56	    Fintype.card (PauliTuple P)
    57	
    58	/-- The complementary uniform probability of the commuting event in
    59	`fact:omega-anticomm-prob`, blueprint `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:151-178`,
    60	paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:70-77`. -/
    61	noncomputable def commProb (P : AdmissibleParams) : ℝ :=
    62	  ((Finset.univ.filter (@IsCommuting P)).card : ℝ) /
    63	    Fintype.card (PauliTuple P)

    71	
    72	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the scalar carrier of an admissible parameter

    75	private theorem pauliScalar_charTwo (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    76	    CharP (PauliScalar P) 2 :=

/-- A zero product remains zero after placement on the first tensor factor. -/
theorem leftPlaced_mul_eq_zero {V W : Type*}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {A B : Op V} (h : A * B = 0) :
    heteroKron A (1 : Op W) * heteroKron B (1 : Op W) = 0 := by
  rw [heteroKron_mul, h]
  ext ⟨i, k⟩ ⟨j, l⟩
  simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]

/-- Incompatible coarse-grained outcomes of two measurements on the Pauli
register have zero product after tensor placement. -/
theorem placedPauliMeasurement_mul_eq_zero_of_incompatible {P : AdmissibleParams}
    {ζ α β : Type*} [Fintype ζ] [DecidableEq ζ]
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (M : Measurement ζ (PauliRegister P))
    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
    (f : ζ → α) (g : ζ → β)
    (a : α) (b : β)
    (hbad : ∀ h, f h = a → g h = b → False) :
    (placedPauliMeasurement M f).effect a *
        (placedPauliMeasurement M g).effect b = 0 := by
  change ((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f).effect a *
      ((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess g).effect b = 0
  exact postprocess_effect_mul_eq_zero_of_incompatible
    (DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M)
    (leftPlacedMeasurement_projective M hM) f g a b hbad

/-- Coarse-grainings of one Pauli basis measurement commute after tensor
placement. -/
theorem placedPauliMeasurement_commute {P : AdmissibleParams}
    {ζ α β : Type*} [Fintype ζ] [DecidableEq ζ]
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (M : Measurement ζ (PauliRegister P))
    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
    (f : ζ → α) (g : ζ → β)
    (a : α) (b : β) :
    Commute ((placedPauliMeasurement M f).effect a)
      ((placedPauliMeasurement M g).effect b) := by
  change Commute
    (((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f).effect a)
    (((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess g).effect b)
  exact postprocess_effect_commute
    (DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M)
    (leftPlacedMeasurement_projective M hM) f g a b

   852	/-- The point/Pair/W trace consistency relation from `def:pauli-win-predicate`,

   856	def pauliPointPairCondition (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   857	    (z : PauliSpace P) (a : PauliScalar P) (β : ZMod 2) : Prop :=
   858	  pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0 ∨
   859	    fixedBinTrace P.model
   860	      (a * (match W with
   861	      | .X => pauliRXBlock z

   864	/-- The Point/Variable consistency clause of `def:pauli-win-predicate`.
   865	The check is gated by `gamma = 0` and only uses Variable 1 in the X basis or
   866	Variable 5 in the Z basis.  Blueprint
   867	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:410-449`; paper origin
   868	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.

   870	def pauliPointVariableCondition (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   871	    (z : PauliSpace P) (j : Fin 9) (a : PauliScalar P) (β : ZMod 2) : Prop :=
   872	  pauliPairGamma P z = 0 ∨
   873	    (j = ⟨0, by decide⟩ ∧ W = .X ∧
   874	        fixedBinTrace P.model (a * pauliRXBlock z) = β) ∨
   875	    (j = ⟨4, by decide⟩ ∧ W = .Z ∧
   876	        fixedBinTrace P.model (a * pauliRZBlock z) = β)

   878	/-- The Pauli win predicate, with constructor-shape rejection.  This is
   879	`def:pauli-win-predicate` in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:410-449`,
   880	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.
   881	-/
   882	noncomputable def pauliWinPredicate (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   883	    PauliQuestion P → PauliQuestion P → PauliAnswer P → PauliAnswer P → Bool :=
   884	  open Classical in
   885	  fun (tA, xA) (tB, xB) a b =>
   886	    if validPauliAnswer tA a && validPauliAnswer tB b then
   887	      if tA = tB then
   888	        decide (a = b)
   889	      else
   890	        match tA, tB, a, b with
   891	      | .aline W, .point W', .alinePoly f, .value u =>
   892	          if W = W' then decide (pauliAlinePointCondition P W xA xB f u) else true
   893	      | .point W, .aline W', .value u, .alinePoly f =>
   894	          if W = W' then decide (pauliAlinePointCondition P W xB xA f u) else true
   895	      | .dline W, .point W', .dlinePoly f, .value u =>
   896	          if W = W' then decide (pauliDlinePointCondition P W xA xB f u) else true
   897	      | .point W, .dline W', .value u, .dlinePoly f =>
   898	          if W = W' then decide (pauliDlinePointCondition P W xB xA f u) else true
   899	      | .point W, .pauli W', .value u, .pauliOutcome h =>
   900	          if W = W' then decide (pauliPointPauliCondition P W xA h u) else true
   901	      | .pauli W, .point W', .pauliOutcome h, .value u =>
   902	          if W = W' then decide (pauliPointPauliCondition P W xB h u) else true
   903	      | .pairW W, .pair, .bit β, .pairBits bits =>
   904	          decide (pauliPairCondition P W xA β bits)
   905	      | .pair, .pairW W, .pairBits bits, .bit β =>
   906	          decide (pauliPairCondition P W xB β bits)
   907	      | .point W, .pairW W', .value u, .bit β =>
   908	          if W = W' then decide (pauliPointPairCondition P W xB u β) else true
   909	      | .pairW W, .point W', .bit β, .value u =>
   910	          if W = W' then decide (pauliPointPairCondition P W xA u β) else true
   911	      | .ms (.constraint i), .ms (.var j), .msTriple β, .bit γ =>
   912	          if ∃ k : Fin 3, msConstraintVars i k = j then
   913	            decide (pauliPairGamma P xA = 0 ∨
   914	              msWinPredicate (.constraint i) (.var j) (.triple β) (.bit γ))
   915	          else true
   916	      | .ms (.var j), .ms (.constraint i), .bit γ, .msTriple β =>
   917	          if ∃ k : Fin 3, msConstraintVars i k = j then
   918	            decide (pauliPairGamma P xB = 0 ∨
   919	              msWinPredicate (.var j) (.constraint i) (.bit γ) (.triple β))
   920	          else true
   921	      | .point W, .ms (.var j), .value u, .bit β =>
   922	          decide (pauliPointVariableCondition P W xB j u β)
   923	      | .ms (.var j), .point W, .bit β, .value u =>
   924	          decide (pauliPointVariableCondition P W xA j u β)
   925	        | _, _, _, _ => true
   926	    else false

   121	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
   122	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   123	    (A : X → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι)
   124	    (B : Y → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement β ι)
   125	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) : Prop :=
   126	  (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsConsistentOn (A x) ψ) ∧

   138	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   139	    (μ : Distribution (G.QuestionA × G.QuestionB))
   140	    (A : G.QuestionA → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement G.AnswerA ι)
   141	    (B : G.QuestionB → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement G.AnswerB ι)
   142	  (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) : Prop :=
   143	  (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A x)) ∧

   151	  (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (S.M x)) ∧ S.IsConsistent ∧

   216	/-- The Born weights of all answer pairs at fixed questions sum to one.  This

   337	/-- Inclusion of answer events implies the corresponding Born-weight inequality. -/
   338	theorem outcome_event_weight_mono {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   339	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB)
   340	    (E F : G.AnswerA → G.AnswerB → Prop) [DecidableRel E] [DecidableRel F]
   341	    (hEF : ∀ a b, E a b → F a b) :
   342	    outcomeEventWeight S x y E ≤ outcomeEventWeight S x y F := by
   343	  unfold outcomeEventWeight
   344	  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   345	  intro a _
   346	  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   347	  intro b _
   348	  by_cases hE : E a b
   349	  · simp [hE, hEF a b hE]
   350	  · simp only [hE, ↓reduceIte]
   351	    split_ifs
   352	    · exact outcomeWeight_nonneg S x y a b

   355	/--
   356	The tensor-product value, expressed as the distribution average of the Born
   357	probabilities.  This is `def:tensor-product-value` in
   358	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:71-82`, with paper origin
   359	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-57`.

   361	noncomputable def Strategy.value {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) : ℝ :=
   362	  avgOver G.μ (fun xy =>
   363	    ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   364	      if G.decide xy.1 xy.2 a b then outcomeWeight S xy.1 xy.2 a b else 0)

   366	/--
   367	The tensor-product game value as a conditional supremum over all finite
   368	strategies.  The `sSup (Set.range ...)` form is the csSup formulation requested

   371	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-57`; attainment is
   372	intentionally not asserted here.

   374	noncomputable def Game.value (G : Game) : ℝ :=
   375	  sSup (Set.range (fun S : Strategy G => S.value))

   559	/-- A symmetric distribution gives the same average after exchanging the two
   560	coordinates, independently of redundant zero-weight support entries. -/
   561	private theorem avgOver_prod_swap_of_weight_symm
   562	    {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
   563	    (μ : Distribution (X × X))
   564	    (hμ : ∀ x y, μ.weight (x, y) = μ.weight (y, x))
   565	    (f : X × X → ℝ) :
   566	    avgOver μ (fun xy => f (xy.2, xy.1)) = avgOver μ f := by
   567	  unfold avgOver
   568	  calc
   569	    (∑ xy ∈ μ.support, μ.weight xy * f (xy.2, xy.1)) =
   570	        ∑ xy : X × X, μ.weight xy * f (xy.2, xy.1) := by
   571	          symm
   572	          exact Distribution.sum_univ_eq_sum_support μ _ fun xy hxy => by
   573	            rw [μ.outsideSupport xy hxy, zero_mul]
   574	    _ = ∑ x : X, ∑ y : X, μ.weight (x, y) * f (y, x) := by
   575	          rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   576	    _ = ∑ y : X, ∑ x : X, μ.weight (x, y) * f (y, x) := Finset.sum_comm
   577	    _ = ∑ y : X, ∑ x : X, μ.weight (y, x) * f (y, x) := by
   578	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   579	          intro y _
   580	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   581	          intro x _
   582	          rw [hμ]
   583	    _ = ∑ xy : X × X, μ.weight xy * f xy := by
   584	          rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   585	    _ = ∑ xy ∈ μ.support, μ.weight xy * f xy :=
   586	      Distribution.sum_univ_eq_sum_support μ _ fun xy hxy => by
   587	        rw [μ.outsideSupport xy hxy, zero_mul]

/-- Symmetry of the Pauli decision predicate in the symmetric game appearing in
`lem:pauli-completeness`. -/
theorem pauliWinPredicate_symm (P : AdmissibleParams)
    (x y : PauliQuestion P) (a b : PauliAnswer P) :
    pauliWinPredicate P x y a b = pauliWinPredicate P y x b a := by
  obtain ⟨tA, xA⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨tB, xB⟩ := y
  by_cases hT : tA = tB
  · subst hT
    simp only [pauliWinPredicate]
    rw [Bool.and_comm (validPauliAnswer tA b) (validPauliAnswer tA a)]
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · simp [hab]
    · simp [hab, Ne.symm hab]
  · cases hvA : validPauliAnswer tA a
    · simp [pauliWinPredicate, hvA]
    · cases hvB : validPauliAnswer tB b
      · simp [pauliWinPredicate, hvB]
      · simp only [pauliWinPredicate, hvA, hvB, Bool.and_self,
          if_neg hT, if_neg (Ne.symm hT)]
        rcases tA with (_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|_|(iA|jA) <;>
          rcases a with uA|fA|gA|bitsA|bitA|trA|hhA <;>
          (try exact Bool.noConfusion hvA) <;>
          rcases tB with (_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|_|(iB|jB) <;>
          rcases b with uB|fB|gB|bitsB|bitB|trB|hhB <;>
          (try exact Bool.noConfusion hvB) <;>
          rfl

/-- The symmetric presentation of the Pauli basis test. The field and basis
are those fixed by `P.model`; no additional model is quantified. -/
noncomputable def pauliBasisTestSymm (P : AdmissibleParams) : SymmetricGame where
  Question := PauliQuestion P
  Answer := PauliAnswer P
  μ := pauliQuestionDistribution P
  μ_prob := (pauliBasisTest P).μ_prob
  μ_symm := pauliQuestionDistribution_symm P
  decide := pauliWinPredicate P
  decide_symm := pauliWinPredicate_symm P

/-- The symmetric presentation has the Pauli basis test as its
underlying game. -/
theorem pauliBasisTestSymm_toGame (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    (pauliBasisTestSymm P).toGame = pauliBasisTest P := by
  rfl

value-one SPCC strategy. Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:390-395`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1229-1421`. -/
theorem exists_spcc_value_one (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    ∃ S : SymmetricStrategy (pauliBasisTestSymm P),
      S.IsSPCC ∧ S.toStrategy.value = 1 := by
  sorry

   113	theorem pointTraceConsistency_eq_mismatch {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

   115	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))

   120	        outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
   121	          (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W u)
   122	          (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W u)
   123	          (fun A B =>
   124	            fixedBinTrace P.model
   125	                (ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero A * r) ≠
   126	              fixedBinTrace P.model
   127	                (ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero B * r))) := by

   134	    (X := X) (uniformDistribution X) S.toStrategy qA qA fA fA

   139	          (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) := by

   142	    unfold ProjectiveSetting.pointTraceMeas ProjectiveSetting.pointMeas fA
   143	    rw [measurement_postprocess_comp_effect]
   144	    rfl

   147	          ((S.pointTraceMeas .bob W u r).effect c) =
   148	        heteroKron (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA)
   149	          (((S.toStrategy.B (qA u)).postprocess (fA u)).effect c) := by
   150	    intro u c
   151	    congr 1
   152	    unfold ProjectiveSetting.pointTraceMeas ProjectiveSetting.pointMeas fA
   153	    rw [measurement_postprocess_comp_effect]
   154	    rfl

   156	    _ = consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution X)
   157	        (fun u c => heteroKron
   158	          (((S.toStrategy.A (qA u)).postprocess (fA u)).effect c) 1)
   159	        (fun u c => heteroKron 1
   160	          (((S.toStrategy.B (qA u)).postprocess (fA u)).effect c))

   164	          (fun A B => fA u A ≠ fA u B)) := h

   171	theorem pointTrace_self_consistency_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

   173	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))

   175	        (fun u b => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointTraceMeas .bob W u r).effect b))
   176	        S.toStrategy.ψ ≤ (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * ε := by
   177	  classical
   178	  rw [pointTraceConsistency_eq_mismatch]
   179	  have hsource :
   180	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   181	          outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
   182	            (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W u)
   183	            (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W u)
   184	            (fun A B =>

   186	                  (ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero A * r) ≠
   187	                fixedBinTrace P.model
   188	                  (ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero B * r))) =
   189	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliSpace P)) (fun z =>

   191	            (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W (pauliToLd P W z).point)
   192	            (ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W (pauliToLd P W z).point)

   194	              fixedBinTrace P.model
   195	                  (ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero A * r) ≠
   196	                fixedBinTrace P.model

   208	    have hpoint := avgOver_ldPoint_uniform P.toLdParams f

   663	    (z : PauliSpace P) (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) :
   664	    Commute (obsOf (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)))
   665	      (obsOf (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z))) := by

   672	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1374-1382`. -/
   673	theorem pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute (P : AdmissibleParams)
   674	    (z : PauliSpace P) (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) (a b : ZMod 2) :
   675	    Commute ((pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a)

   677	  have hOO :

   679	        (tauObservable PauliKind.Z (pauliRZBlock z • indicatorVec (pauliZBlock z))) := by

   682	    exact obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_commute P z hgamma
   683	  rw [pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_eq_reflectionEffect,
   684	    pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_eq_reflectionEffect]
   685	  exact reflectionEffect_commute hOO a b

   688	`eq:pair-definition`, paper
   689	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1339`. -/
   690	noncomputable def pauliPairEffect (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
   691	    (β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) : Op (PauliRegister P) :=
   692	  (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect β.1 *

   699	    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) (β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) :
   700	    IsProj (pauliPairEffect P z β) :=
   701	  IsStarProjection.mul (pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .X _ _ β.1)

   703	    (pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute P z hgamma β.1 β.2)

   706	theorem sum_pauliPairEffect (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P) :
   707	    ∑ β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, pauliPairEffect P z β = 1 := by
   708	  calc ∑ β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, pauliPairEffect P z β
   709	      = ∑ a : ZMod 2, ∑ b : ZMod 2,
   710	          (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a *
   711	            (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b :=
   712	        Fintype.sum_prod_type _
   713	    _ = ∑ a : ZMod 2,
   714	          (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a *
   715	            ∑ b : ZMod 2,
   716	              (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b :=
   717	        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   718	    _ = 1 := by
   719	        rw [(pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).sum_eq_one]
   720	        simp [(pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).sum_eq_one]

   291	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
   292	`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (`thm:ms-from-ac`, blueprint

   335	    (P : Fin 9 → Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
   336	    (hP : ∀ j, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (P j))

   347	  | constraint i =>

   357	theorem postprocess_effect_transpose
   358	    {α β V : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
   359	    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   360	    (M : Measurement α V) (f : α → β)
   361	    (hM : ∀ a, (M.effect a)ᵀ = M.effect a) (b : β) :
   362	    ((M.postprocess f).effect b)ᵀ = (M.postprocess f).effect b := by
   363	  rw [Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   364	  ext r c
   365	  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply]
   366	  rw [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.sum_apply]
   367	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   368	  intro a _
   369	  exact congrFun (congrFun (hM a) r) c

   371	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for

   376	theorem msConstraintJoint_effect_transpose
   377	    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   378	    (P : Fin 9 → Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
   379	    (hP : ∀ j, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (P j))

   382	        ((P (msConstraintVars i l)).effect b))

   387	  change (((P (msConstraintVars i 0)).effect ab.1 *
   388	    (P (msConstraintVars i 1)).effect ab.2)ᵀ) = _
   389	  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hPt, hPt]
   390	  exact (hcomm i 0 1 ab.1 ab.2).symm.eq
   391	
   392	private theorem msConstraintObservable_product_parity
   393	    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   394	    (OA OB : Op V) (hOA : OA * OA = 1) (hOB : OB * OB = 1)
   395	    (hac : OA * OB = -(OB * OA)) (i : Fin 6) :
   396	    (msParity i = 0 ∧
   397	      msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 0) *
   398	          msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 1) *
   399	          msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 2) = 1) ∨
   400	    (msParity i = 1 ∧
   401	      msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 0) *
   402	          msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 1) *
   403	          msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 2) = -1) := by
   404	  have hprod := msConstraintObservable_product OA OB hOA hOB hac i
   405	  fin_cases i <;> simpa [msParity] using hprod
   406	
   407	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
   408	`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (`thm:ms-from-ac`, blueprint
   409	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:257-267`): multiplying a constraint effect at `ab` by the
   410	effect of an incident cell measurement at `b` returns the constraint effect when
   411	`b` is the bit that the parity triple assigns to that cell, and `0` otherwise;
   412	this is the consistency of the constraint answer with its variable answers. -/
   413	theorem msCellConstraintJoint_mul
   414	    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   415	    (OA OB : Op V) (hOA : OAᴴ = OA) (hOB : OBᴴ = OB)
   416	    (hOA_sq : OA * OA = 1) (hOB_sq : OB * OB = 1)
   417	    (hac : OA * OB = -(OB * OA))
   418	    (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) (ab : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
   419	    let P := msCellMeasurement OA OB hOA hOB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac
   420	    (msConstraintJoint P
   421	        (msCellMeasurement_projective OA OB hOA hOB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac)
   422	        (fun i k l a b => reflectionEffect_commute
   423	          (msConstraintObservable_commute OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac i k l) a b)
   424	        i).effect ab * (P (msConstraintVars i k)).effect b =
   425	      if parityTriple i ab k = b then
   426	        (msConstraintJoint P
   427	          (msCellMeasurement_projective OA OB hOA hOB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac)
   428	          (fun i k l a b => reflectionEffect_commute
   429	            (msConstraintObservable_commute OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac i k l) a b)
   430	          i).effect ab else 0 := by
   431	  let P := msCellMeasurement OA OB hOA hOB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac
   432	  let hP := msCellMeasurement_projective OA OB hOA hOB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac
   433	  let hcomm : ∀ i k l a b,
   434	      Commute ((P (msConstraintVars i k)).effect a)
   435	        ((P (msConstraintVars i l)).effect b) :=
   436	    fun i k l a b => reflectionEffect_commute
   437	      (msConstraintObservable_commute OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac i k l) a b
   438	  fin_cases k
   439	  · simpa [parityTriple, msConstraintJoint, P, hP, hcomm] using
   440	      binaryJointMeasurement_mul_first (P (msConstraintVars i 0))
   441	        (P (msConstraintVars i 1)) (hP _) (hP _) (hcomm i 0 1) ab b
   442	  · simpa [parityTriple, msConstraintJoint, P, hP, hcomm] using
   443	      binaryJointMeasurement_mul_second (P (msConstraintVars i 0))
   444	        (P (msConstraintVars i 1)) (hP _) (hP _) (hcomm i 0 1) ab b
   445	  · change
   446	      (reflectionEffect (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 0)) ab.1 *
   447	          reflectionEffect (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 1)) ab.2) *
   448	          reflectionEffect (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 2)) b =
   449	        if msParity i - ab.1 - ab.2 = b then
   450	          reflectionEffect (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 0)) ab.1 *
   451	            reflectionEffect (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 1)) ab.2
   452	        else 0
   453	    by_cases hb : msParity i - ab.1 - ab.2 = b
   454	    · rw [if_pos hb]
   455	      subst b
   456	      exact reflection_pair_absorbs_parity_effect
   457	        (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 0))
   458	        (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 1))
   459	        (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 2))
   460	        (msCellObservable_sq OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac _)
   461	        (msCellObservable_sq OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac _)
   462	        (msConstraintObservable_commute OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac i 0 1)
   463	        (msParity i) ab.1 ab.2
   464	        (msConstraintObservable_product_parity OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac i)
   465	    · rw [if_neg hb]
   466	      have habsorb := reflection_pair_absorbs_parity_effect
   467	        (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 0))
   468	        (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 1))
   469	        (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 2))
   470	        (msCellObservable_sq OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac _)
   471	        (msCellObservable_sq OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac _)
   472	        (msConstraintObservable_commute OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac i 0 1)
   473	        (msParity i) ab.1 ab.2
   474	        (msConstraintObservable_product_parity OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac i)
   475	      rw [← habsorb, mul_assoc]
   476	      rw [show reflectionEffect
   477	          (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 2))
   478	            (msParity i - ab.1 - ab.2) *
   479	          reflectionEffect (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 2)) b = 0 by
   480	        change
   481	          (reflectionMeasurement
   482	            (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 2))
   483	            (msCellObservable_conjTranspose OA OB hOA hOB hac _)
   484	            (msCellObservable_sq OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac _)).effect
   485	              (msParity i - ab.1 - ab.2) *
   486	            (reflectionMeasurement
   487	              (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 2))
   488	              (msCellObservable_conjTranspose OA OB hOA hOB hac _)
   489	              (msCellObservable_sq OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac _)).effect b = 0
   490	        rw [binary_effect_mul
   491	          (reflectionMeasurement
   492	            (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 2))
   493	            (msCellObservable_conjTranspose OA OB hOA hOB hac _)
   494	            (msCellObservable_sq OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac _))
   495	          (reflectionMeasurement_projective
   496	            (msCellObservable OA OB (msConstraintVars i 2))
   497	            (msCellObservable_conjTranspose OA OB hOA hOB hac _)
   498	            (msCellObservable_sq OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac _))
   499	          (msParity i - ab.1 - ab.2) b]
   500	        simp [hb]]
   501	      simp
   502	
   503	end

     7	/-!
     8	# The honest Pauli basis measurements of the completeness proof
     9	
    10	This module builds the measurements used by the honest strategy of
    11	`lem:pauli-completeness`: the generalized Pauli basis measurement in a fixed
    12	basis `W`, and its coarse-graining by the binary trace
    13	`h ↦ tr(g_h(u_W) r_W)` which the source calls `A` (for `W = X`) and `B`
    14	(for `W = Z`).  The main results are the observable identity
    15	
    16	  `A_0 - A_1 = τ^W(ind_m(u_W) r_W)`
    17	
    18	of `eq:finally-got-an-observable`, and the resulting commutation law
    19	
    20	  `𝒪_A 𝒪_B = (-1)^γ 𝒪_B 𝒪_A`
    21	
    22	with `γ` the phase bit `eq:gamma-value`.  When `γ ≠ 0` the two observables
    23	anticommute, so `thm:ms-from-ac` produces the Magic Square part of the honest
    24	strategy.
    25	
    26	## References
    27	
    28	The construction is the strategy displayed in the proof of
    29	`lem:pauli-completeness`,
    30	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1360`;
    31	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:390-395`.
    32	-/
    33	
    34	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    35	
    36	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    37	
    38	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    39	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    40	
    41	noncomputable section
    42	
    43	variable {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod 2) K]
    44	  [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    45	
    46	/-! ### The generalized Pauli basis measurement -/
    47	
    48	/-- The generalized Pauli observable at the zero label is the identity.  This is
    49	the normalization implicit in `def:generalized-pauli`, blueprint
    50	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:529-571`, paper origin
    51	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1052-1096`. -/
    52	theorem tauObservable_zero (W : PauliKind) :
    53	    tauObservable W (0 : ι → K) = 1 := by
    54	  have hmul := tauObservable_mul W (0 : ι → K) 0
    55	  rw [add_zero, tauObservable_sq] at hmul
    56	  exact hmul.symm
    57	
    58	/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is positive semidefinite: it is the
    59	rank-one projector onto the corresponding basis vector of
    60	`def:generalized-pauli`, blueprint `ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:529-571`, paper origin
    61	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1101-1122`. -/
    62	theorem pauliProj_posSemidef (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) :
    63	    (pauliProj W e).PosSemidef :=
    64	  Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (pauliVec W e)
    65	
    66	/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is a nonnegative operator. -/
    67	theorem pauliProj_nonneg (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) : 0 ≤ pauliProj W e :=
    68	  Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (pauliProj_posSemidef W e)
    69	
    70	/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is Hermitian. -/
    71	theorem pauliProj_conjTranspose (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) :
    72	    (pauliProj W e)ᴴ = pauliProj W e :=
    73	  (pauliProj_posSemidef W e).isHermitian.eq
    74	
    75	/-- The generalized Pauli projectors in a fixed basis form a resolution of the
    76	identity.  This is the completeness half of `def:generalized-pauli`, blueprint
    77	`ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:529-571`, paper origin
    78	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1101-1122`. -/
    79	theorem sum_pauliProj (W : PauliKind) :
    80	    ∑ e : ι → K, pauliProj W e = 1 := by
    81	  have h := tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj (K := K) (ι := ι) W 0
    82	  rw [tauObservable_zero] at h
    83	  refine Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_) h.symm
    84	  have hzero : dotProduct (0 : ι → K) e = 0 := by simp
    85	  simp [hzero, phaseSign]
    86	
    87	/-- The generalized Pauli basis measurement in basis `W`: the projective
    88	measurement whose outcomes are the labels of `def:generalized-pauli`, blueprint
    89	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:529-571`, paper origin
    90	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1101-1122`. -/
    91	noncomputable def pauliBasisMeasurement (W : PauliKind) :
    92	    Measurement (ι → K) (ι → K) :=
    93	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne (pauliProj W) (pauliProj_nonneg W) (sum_pauliProj W)
    94	
    95	@[simp] theorem pauliBasisMeasurement_effect (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) :
    96	    (pauliBasisMeasurement W).effect e = pauliProj W e := rfl

    98	/-! ### Symmetry and Hermiticity of the generalized Pauli observables -/
    99	
   100	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the binary sign character is real. -/
   101	private theorem star_phaseSign' (t : ZMod 2) : star (phaseSign t) = phaseSign t := by
   102	  by_cases ht : t = 0 <;> simp [phaseSign, ht]
   103	
   104	omit [Fintype K] in
   105	/-- Generalized Pauli observables are symmetric matrices in the computational
   106	basis.  Symmetry is what makes the honest measurements consistent on the EPR
   107	state used by `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
   108	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1360`. -/
   109	theorem tauObservable_transpose (W : PauliKind) (a : ι → K) :
   110	    (tauObservable W a)ᵀ = tauObservable W a := by
   111	  haveI : CharP K 2 := (Algebra.charP_iff (ZMod 2) K 2).mp (ZMod.charP 2)
   112	  have hswap : ∀ x y c : K, (x = y + c) ↔ (y = x + c) := by
   113	    intro x y c
   114	    constructor
   115	    · rintro rfl
   116	      rw [add_assoc, CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero, add_zero]
   117	    · rintro rfl
   118	      rw [add_assoc, CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero, add_zero]
   119	  ext x y
   120	  rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]
   121	  cases W with
   122	  | X =>
   123	      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
   124	      change (if y i = x i + a i then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = if x i = y i + a i then 1 else 0
   125	      by_cases h : x i = y i + a i
   126	      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ((hswap _ _ _).mp h)]
   127	      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h ((hswap _ _ _).mp hc))]
   128	  | Z =>
   129	      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
   130	      change (if y i = x i then phaseSign (binTrace K (a i * x i)) else 0) =
   131	        if x i = y i then phaseSign (binTrace K (a i * y i)) else 0
   132	      by_cases h : x i = y i
   133	      · rw [h]
   134	      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h hc.symm)]
   135	
   136	/-- Generalized Pauli observables are Hermitian.  This is the self-adjointness
   137	of the observables `𝒪_A` and `𝒪_B` used in the proof of
   138	`lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
   139	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1360`. -/
   140	theorem tauObservable_conjTranspose (W : PauliKind) (a : ι → K) :
   141	    (tauObservable W a)ᴴ = tauObservable W a := by
   142	  rw [tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj, Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
   143	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
   144	  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, star_phaseSign', pauliProj_conjTranspose]
   145	
   146	/-! ### Orthogonality of the generalized Pauli projectors
   147	
   148	The generalized Pauli projectors in a fixed basis are pairwise orthogonal, so
   149	every coarse-graining of a Pauli basis measurement is again projective.  This is
   150	the projectivity used throughout the honest strategy of `lem:pauli-completeness`,
   151	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1370`.
   152	-/
   153	
   154	
   155	/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is a projector. -/
   156	theorem pauliProj_isProj (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) : IsProj (pauliProj W e) := by
   157	  refine isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   158	  · simpa using pauliProj_mul_pauliProj W e e
   159	  · rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, pauliProj_conjTranspose]
   160	
   161	/-- Every coarse-graining of a generalized Pauli basis measurement is
   162	projective.  This is the projectivity of the honest Point, Line and Pauli
   163	measurements in the proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
   164	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1370`. -/
   165	theorem pauliBasisMeasurement_postprocess_projective {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
   166	    [DecidableEq β] (W : PauliKind) (g : (ι → K) → β) :
   167	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective ((pauliBasisMeasurement W).postprocess g) := by
   168	  classical
   169	  intro b
   170	  rw [Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   171	  refine isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   172	  · rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
   173	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e he => ?_
   174	    have hterm : ∀ f ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a : ι → K => g a = b),
   175	        (pauliBasisMeasurement W).effect e * (pauliBasisMeasurement W).effect f =
   176	          if e = f then pauliProj W e else 0 :=
   177	      fun f _ => pauliProj_mul_pauliProj W e f

   662	theorem obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_commute (P : AdmissibleParams)

   664	    Commute (obsOf (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)))

   673	theorem pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute (P : AdmissibleParams)
   674	    (z : PauliSpace P) (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) (a b : ZMod 2) :
   675	    Commute ((pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a)

   677	  have hOO :

   684	    pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_eq_reflectionEffect]
   685	  exact reflectionEffect_commute hOO a b

   688	`eq:pair-definition`, paper
   689	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1339`. -/
   690	noncomputable def pauliPairEffect (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
   691	    (β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) : Op (PauliRegister P) :=
   692	  (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect β.1 *

   698	theorem pauliPairEffect_isProj (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
   699	    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) (β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) :
   700	    IsProj (pauliPairEffect P z β) :=
   701	  IsStarProjection.mul (pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .X _ _ β.1)

   706	theorem sum_pauliPairEffect (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P) :
   707	    ∑ β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, pauliPairEffect P z β = 1 := by
   708	  calc ∑ β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, pauliPairEffect P z β
   709	      = ∑ a : ZMod 2, ∑ b : ZMod 2,
   710	          (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a *
   711	            (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b :=
   712	        Fintype.sum_prod_type _
   713	    _ = ∑ a : ZMod 2,
   714	          (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a *
   715	            ∑ b : ZMod 2,
   716	              (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b :=
   717	        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]

    (E F : Op V) (hFt : Fᵀ = F) (hEF : E * F = 0) :
    (inner ℂ (eprState V)
      (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron E F) (eprState V))).re = 0 := by
  have hzero := heteroKron_mulVec_epr_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero E F hFt hEF
  have hacted : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron E F) (eprState V) = 0 := by
    rw [applyOperatorToState, Matrix.toLpLin_apply, hzero]
    rfl
  rw [hacted]
  simp

example (e : PauliEdge) : True := by
  rcases e with ⟨⟨t, u⟩, h⟩
  simp [pauliEdges] at h
  trace_state
  trivial

example (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    ∃ S : SymmetricStrategy (pauliBasisTestSymm P),
      S.IsSPCC ∧ S.toStrategy.value = 1 := by
  let S : SymmetricStrategy (pauliBasisTestSymm P) := {
    ι := HonestIndex P
    ψ := eprState (HonestIndex P)
    ψ_norm := eprState_norm (HonestIndex P)
    ψ_swap := reindexState_prodComm_eprState (HonestIndex P)
    M := fun q => honestMeasurement P q.1 q.2
  }
  refine ⟨S, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q
      exact honestMeasurement_projective P q.1 q.2
    · intro q
      -- consistency
      intro a
      exact epr_action_eq_of_transpose _
        (honestMeasurement_effect_transpose P q.1 q.2 a)
    · intro x y hxy a b
      sorry
  · sorry

end

    10	polynomial whose degree is at most the number of coordinates in which the
    11	direction of the line is nonzero: at most `m ≤ m*d` on every line and at most
    12	`1 ≤ d` on an axis-parallel line.

     4	/-!
     5	# Pauli-register line projectors
     6	
     7	This module constructs the projective measurement `tau^{W,line}` of one
     8	generalized-Pauli register whose outcome is the restriction to a canonical
     9	line of the low-degree encoding of the measured basis label. It records that
    10	the outcome projectors are orthogonal projections summing to the identity,
    11	that they are symmetric matrices (so that they act identically on either half
    12	of an EPR pair), and that on an axis-parallel line they vanish outside the
    13	embedded degree-`d` subspace.
    14	
    15	## References
    16	
    17	The projectors are `tau^{W,line}_{f''}` in `def:expanded-line-measurement`,
    18	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1034-1080`, with paper source
    19	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:535-557`. Their
    20	perfect self-consistency on an EPR pair is the ancillary input to item 1 of
    21	`lem:qld-comm-line-cons`, paper
    22	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:559-568`.
    23	-/

    37	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:535-557`, blueprint
    38	`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1034-1080`. -/

    41	    Op (PauliRegister P) :=
    42	  ∑ h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun h : PauliRegister P =>
    43	      restrictToLine P.toLdParams line (lowDegreeEncoding h) = f),
    44	    pauliProj W h

    51	  Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
    52	    (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (pauliVec W e))

    60	  classical

   112	    ∑ e : PauliRegister P, pauliProj W e = 1 := by
   113	  have hzero : tauObservable W (0 : PauliRegister P) = 1 := by

   115	    rw [add_zero, tauObservable_sq] at hmul

   138	/-- The projective line measurement on one Pauli register obtained by

/-!
# Completeness of the Pauli basis test

This file presents the Pauli basis test as a symmetric game and states its
value-one SPCC completeness theorem.  The honest measurements entering that
theorem are constructed in `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Completeness.HonestStrategy`.

## References

The source statement is `lem:pauli-completeness` in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:390-395`, from
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1229-1421`.
-/

/-! ### Auxiliary facts about finite distributions

The lemmas of this section are formalization-only.  They record elementary
identities about finite weighted distributions which the source treats as
implicit.
-/

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: two finite distributions coincide as soon as
their supports and their weight functions coincide. -/
private theorem distribution_ext {α : Type*} {μ ν : Distribution α}
    (hsupport : μ.support = ν.support) (hweight : μ.weight = ν.weight) : μ = ν := by
  cases μ with
  | mk s w hn ho =>
    cases ν with
    | mk s' w' hn' ho' =>
      have hs : s = s' := hsupport
      have hw : w = w' := hweight
      subst hs
      subst hw
      rfl

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: successive push-forwards compose. -/
private theorem distribution_map_map {α β γ : Type*}
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (μ : Distribution α) (e : α → β) (f : β → γ) :
    (μ.map e).map f = μ.map fun a => f (e a) := by
  refine distribution_ext ?_ ?_
  · change (μ.support.image e).image f = μ.support.image fun a => f (e a)
    rw [Finset.image_image]
    rfl
  · funext c
    have hmaps : ∀ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => f (e a) = c,
        e a ∈ (μ.support.image e).filter fun b => f b = c := by
      intro a ha
      obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ha1, ha2⟩
    have hkey := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps μ.weight
    change (∑ b ∈ (μ.support.image e).filter fun b => f b = c,
        ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => e a = b, μ.weight a) =
      ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => f (e a) = c, μ.weight a
    rw [← hkey]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => ?_
    obtain ⟨-, hb2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hb
    congr 1
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ha1, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨ha1, hb2⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨ha1, -⟩, hae⟩
      exact ⟨ha1, hae⟩

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the push-forward of a uniform distribution
does not depend on the finiteness and decidability data used to form it. -/
private theorem map_uniformDistribution_congr {α γ : Type*}
    (i₁ i₂ : Fintype α) (j₁ j₂ : DecidableEq α) (k₁ k₂ : Nonempty α)
    (d₁ d₂ : DecidableEq γ) (e : α → γ) :
    @Distribution.map α γ d₁ (@uniformDistribution α i₁ j₁ k₁) e =
      @Distribution.map α γ d₂ (@uniformDistribution α i₂ j₂ k₂) e := by
  have hi : i₁ = i₂ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hj : j₁ = j₂ := funext fun _ => funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hd : d₁ = d₂ := funext fun _ => funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst hi
  subst hj
  subst hd
  rfl

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: a uniformly seeded typed bind does not depend
on the finiteness and decidability data used to form it. -/
private theorem bind_map_uniformDistribution_congr {α β γ : Type*}
    (i₁ i₂ : Fintype β) (j₁ j₂ : DecidableEq β) (k₁ k₂ : Nonempty β)
    (d₁ d₂ : DecidableEq γ) (μ : Distribution α) (g : α → β → γ) :
    @Distribution.bind α γ d₁ μ
        (fun a => @Distribution.map β γ d₁ (@uniformDistribution β i₁ j₁ k₁) (g a)) =
      @Distribution.bind α γ d₂ μ
        (fun a => @Distribution.map β γ d₂ (@uniformDistribution β i₂ j₂ k₂) (g a)) := by
  have hi : i₁ = i₂ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hj : j₁ = j₂ := funext fun _ => funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hd : d₁ = d₂ := funext fun _ => funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst hi
  subst hj
  subst hd
  rfl

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: every point of a finite type carries the same
uniform weight. -/
private theorem uniform_weight_apply (α : Type*)
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] (a : α) :
    (uniformDistribution α).weight a = 1 / (Fintype.card α : Error) := by
  simp [uniformDistribution]

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: a push-forward of a uniform distribution
weights a value by the size of its fibre. -/
private theorem uniform_map_weight {α γ : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] [DecidableEq γ]
    (e : α → γ) (c : γ) :
    ((uniformDistribution α).map e).weight c =
      (((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun x => e x = c).card : Error) *
        (1 / (Fintype.card α : Error)) := by
  change (∑ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).filter (fun x => e x = c),
      (uniformDistribution α).weight x) = _
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => uniform_weight_apply α x,
    Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: binding a uniform distribution on a finite
edge set to uniformly seeded push-forwards is the push-forward of the uniform
distribution on the product of an indexing type for that edge set with the
seed space. -/
private theorem bind_uniformOnFinset_map {α β γ σ : Type*}
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [Nonempty σ]
    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (f : σ → α) (hinj : Function.Injective f)
    (hmem : ∀ a, a ∈ s ↔ ∃ x : σ, f x = a) (g : α → β → γ) :
    Distribution.bind (Distribution.uniformOnFinset s)
        (fun a => (uniformDistribution β).map (g a)) =
      (uniformDistribution (σ × β)).map fun q => g (f q.1) q.2 := by
  classical
  have himage : (Finset.univ : Finset σ).image f = s := by
    ext a
    simp [hmem a]
  have hcard : s.card = Fintype.card σ := by
    rw [← himage, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj, Finset.card_univ]
  have hsum : ∀ h : α → Error, ∑ a ∈ s, h a = ∑ x : σ, h (f x) := by
    intro h
    rw [← himage, Finset.sum_image fun x _ y _ hxy => hinj hxy]
  refine distribution_ext ?_ ?_
  · change s.biUnion (fun a => (Finset.univ : Finset β).image (g a)) =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (σ × β)).image fun q => g (f q.1) q.2
    ext c
    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Prod.exists]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨xx, rfl⟩ := (hmem a).mp ha
      exact ⟨xx, b, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨xx, b, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨f xx, (hmem _).mpr ⟨xx, rfl⟩, b, rfl⟩
  · funext c
    have key : ∀ a ∈ s, (Distribution.uniformOnFinset s).weight a *
        ((uniformDistribution β).map (g a)).weight c =
        (((Finset.univ : Finset β).filter fun b => g a b = c).card : Error) *
          (1 / ((Fintype.card σ : Error) * (Fintype.card β : Error))) := by
      intro a ha
      rw [Distribution.uniformOnFinset_weight, if_pos ha, uniform_map_weight, hcard]
      ring
    have hcount :
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (σ × β)).filter fun q => g (f q.1) q.2 = c).card =
          ∑ x : σ, ((Finset.univ : Finset β).filter fun b => g (f x) b = c).card := by
      simp only [Finset.card_filter]
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    change (∑ a ∈ s, (Distribution.uniformOnFinset s).weight a *
        ((uniformDistribution β).map (g a)).weight c) =
      ∑ q ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (σ × β)).filter fun q => g (f q.1) q.2 = c,
        (uniformDistribution (σ × β)).weight q
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl key,
      hsum fun a => (((Finset.univ : Finset β).filter fun b => g a b = c).card : Error) *
        (1 / ((Fintype.card σ : Error) * (Fintype.card β : Error))),
      ← Finset.sum_mul,
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => uniform_weight_apply (σ × β) q,
      Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hcount, Fintype.card_prod]
    push_cast
    ring

/-! ### The Pauli question sampler as a typed conditionally linear distribution -/

/-- The Pauli question sampler equals the typed conditionally linear distribution
on the Pauli type graph from `def:typed-cl-distributions`; blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:624-629`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/07_types.tex:84-94`. -/
theorem pauliQuestionDistribution_eq_typedCL (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    pauliQuestionDistribution P =
      typedCLDistribution pauliEdges (by
        refine ⟨Sym2.mk (.point .X) (.point .X), ?_⟩
        simp [pauliEdges]) (pauliCL P) (pauliCL P) := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty PauliEdge := pauliEdge_nonempty
  have hmem : ∀ ab : PauliType × PauliType,
      ab ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (PauliType × PauliType)).filter
          (fun ab => Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ pauliEdges) ↔
        ∃ e : PauliEdge, e.val = ab := by
    intro ab
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨⟨ab, (Finset.mem_filter.mp h).2⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, e.2⟩
  have hmine : Distribution.bind
      (Distribution.uniformOnFinset ((Finset.univ : Finset (PauliType × PauliType)).filter
        (fun ab => Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ pauliEdges)))
      (fun uv => (uniformDistribution (PauliSpace P)).map fun z =>
        ((uv.1, pauliCL P uv.1 z), (uv.2, pauliCL P uv.2 z))) =
      pauliQuestionDistribution P := by
    rw [bind_uniformOnFinset_map _ (Subtype.val : PauliEdge → PauliType × PauliType)
      Subtype.val_injective hmem
      (fun uv z => ((uv.1, pauliCL P uv.1 z), (uv.2, pauliCL P uv.2 z)))]
    unfold pauliQuestionDistribution
    exact map_uniformDistribution_congr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  rw [← hmine]
  simp only [typedCLDistribution, graphDistribution, clDistribution,
    distribution_map_map]
  exact bind_map_uniformDistribution_congr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _

/-!

This module builds the measurements used by the honest strategy of
`lem:pauli-completeness`: the generalized Pauli basis measurement in a fixed
basis `W`, and its coarse-graining by the binary trace
`h ↦ tr(g_h(u_W) r_W)` which the source calls `A` (for `W = X`) and `B`
(for `W = Z`).  The main results are the observable identity

of `eq:finally-got-an-observable`, and the resulting commutation law

  `𝒪_A 𝒪_B = (-1)^γ 𝒪_B 𝒪_A`

with `γ` the phase bit `eq:gamma-value`.  When `γ ≠ 0` the two observables
anticommute, so `thm:ms-from-ac` produces the Magic Square part of the honest
strategy.

## References

The construction is the strategy displayed in the proof of
`lem:pauli-completeness`,
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1360`;
blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:390-395`.

variable {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod 2) K]
  [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

/-! ### The generalized Pauli basis measurement -/

/-- The generalized Pauli observable at the zero label is the identity.  This is
the normalization implicit in `def:generalized-pauli`, blueprint
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:529-571`, paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1052-1096`. -/
theorem tauObservable_zero (W : PauliKind) :
    tauObservable W (0 : ι → K) = 1 := by
  have hmul := tauObservable_mul W (0 : ι → K) 0
  rw [add_zero, tauObservable_sq] at hmul
  exact hmul.symm

/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is positive semidefinite: it is the
rank-one projector onto the corresponding basis vector of
`def:generalized-pauli`, blueprint `ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:529-571`, paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1101-1122`. -/
theorem pauliProj_posSemidef (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) :
    (pauliProj W e).PosSemidef :=
  Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (pauliVec W e)

/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is a nonnegative operator. -/
theorem pauliProj_nonneg (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) : 0 ≤ pauliProj W e :=
  Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (pauliProj_posSemidef W e)

/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is Hermitian. -/
theorem pauliProj_conjTranspose (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) :
    (pauliProj W e)ᴴ = pauliProj W e :=
  (pauliProj_posSemidef W e).isHermitian.eq

/-- The generalized Pauli projectors in a fixed basis form a resolution of the
identity.  This is the completeness half of `def:generalized-pauli`, blueprint
`ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:529-571`, paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1101-1122`. -/
theorem sum_pauliProj (W : PauliKind) :
    ∑ e : ι → K, pauliProj W e = 1 := by
  have h := tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj (K := K) (ι := ι) W 0
  rw [tauObservable_zero] at h
  refine Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_) h.symm
  have hzero : dotProduct (0 : ι → K) e = 0 := by simp
  simp [hzero, phaseSign]

/-- The generalized Pauli basis measurement in basis `W`: the projective
measurement whose outcomes are the labels of `def:generalized-pauli`, blueprint
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:529-571`, paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1101-1122`. -/
noncomputable def pauliBasisMeasurement (W : PauliKind) :
    Measurement (ι → K) (ι → K) :=
  Measurement.ofSumEqOne (pauliProj W) (pauliProj_nonneg W) (sum_pauliProj W)

@[simp] theorem pauliBasisMeasurement_effect (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) :
    (pauliBasisMeasurement W).effect e = pauliProj W e := rfl

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the binary sign character is real. -/
private theorem star_phaseSign' (t : ZMod 2) : star (phaseSign t) = phaseSign t := by
  by_cases ht : t = 0 <;> simp [phaseSign, ht]

/-- Generalized Pauli observables are symmetric matrices in the computational
basis.  Symmetry is what makes the honest measurements consistent on the EPR
state used by `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1360`. -/
theorem tauObservable_transpose (W : PauliKind) (a : ι → K) :

  haveI : CharP K 2 := (Algebra.charP_iff (ZMod 2) K 2).mp (ZMod.charP 2)

    intro x y c

  | X =>
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      change (if y i = x i + a i then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = if x i = y i + a i then 1 else 0

      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ((hswap _ _ _).mp h)]

      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h hc.symm)]

of the observables `𝒪_A` and `𝒪_B` used in the proof of
`lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1360`. -/
theorem tauObservable_conjTranspose (W : PauliKind) (a : ι → K) :
    (tauObservable W a)ᴴ = tauObservable W a := by
  rw [tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj, Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, star_phaseSign', pauliProj_conjTranspose]

/-! ### Orthogonality of the generalized Pauli projectors

The generalized Pauli projectors in a fixed basis are pairwise orthogonal, so
every coarse-graining of a Pauli basis measurement is again projective.  This is
the projectivity used throughout the honest strategy of `lem:pauli-completeness`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1370`.
-/


/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is a projector. -/
theorem pauliProj_isProj (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) : IsProj (pauliProj W e) := by
  refine isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using pauliProj_mul_pauliProj W e e
  · rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, pauliProj_conjTranspose]

/-- Every coarse-graining of a generalized Pauli basis measurement is
projective.  This is the projectivity of the honest Point, Line and Pauli
measurements in the proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1370`. -/
theorem pauliBasisMeasurement_postprocess_projective {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq β] (W : PauliKind) (g : (ι → K) → β) :
    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective ((pauliBasisMeasurement W).postprocess g) := by
  classical
  intro b
  rw [Measurement.postprocess_effect]
  refine isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e he => ?_
    have hterm : ∀ f ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a : ι → K => g a = b),
        (pauliBasisMeasurement W).effect e * (pauliBasisMeasurement W).effect f =
          if e = f then pauliProj W e else 0 :=
      fun f _ => pauliProj_mul_pauliProj W e f
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem _ e (fun _ => pauliProj W e) he]
    rfl
  · rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
    exact pauliProj_conjTranspose W e

/-- Every coarse-graining of a generalized Pauli basis measurement has symmetric
effects, hence is consistent on the EPR state.  This is the consistency of the
honest Point, Line and Pauli measurements in the proof of
`lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1368-1372`. -/
theorem pauliBasisMeasurement_postprocess_isConsistentOn {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty ι] (W : PauliKind) (g : (ι → K) → β) :
    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsConsistentOn ((pauliBasisMeasurement W).postprocess g)
      (eprState (ι → K)) := by
  classical
  intro b
  refine epr_action_eq_of_transpose _ ?_
  rw [Measurement.postprocess_effect, Matrix.transpose_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  exact pauliProj_transpose W e

/-! ### The honest Pair/W measurements

For an ambient question `ω = (u_X, u_Z, r_X, r_Z)` the honest player measures
the Pauli register in basis `W` and reports the binary trace
`tr(g_h(u_W) r_W)` of the resulting label.  These are the measurements `A` and
`B` of the proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`,
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1330`.
-/

/-- The binary trace bit `tr(g_h(u) r)` reported by the honest Pair/W
measurement on the Pauli label `h`.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1330`. -/
noncomputable def pauliTraceBit (P : AdmissibleParams)
    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (r : PauliScalar P) (h : PauliRegister P) : ZMod 2 :=
  fixedBinTrace P.model (lowDegreeEnc h u * r)

/-- The honest Pair/W measurement `τ^W_{[tr(g_·(u) r) = β]}` of the proof of
`lem:pauli-completeness`: the generalized Pauli basis measurement coarse-grained
by the trace bit.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1330`,
blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:390-395`. -/
noncomputable def pauliTraceMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (r : PauliScalar P) :
    Measurement (ZMod 2) (PauliRegister P) :=
  (pauliBasisMeasurement W).postprocess (pauliTraceBit P u r)

theorem pauliTraceMeasurement_effect (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (r : PauliScalar P) (b : ZMod 2) :
    (pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r).effect b =
      ∑ h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun h : PauliRegister P => pauliTraceBit P u r h = b),
        pauliProj W h := rfl

/-- Equation `eq:finally-got-an-observable`: the observable of the honest
Pair/W measurement is the generalized Pauli observable at the label
`ind_m(u) r`.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1300-1315`. -/

    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (r : PauliScalar P) :
    obsOf (pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r) =
      tauObservable W (r • indicatorVec u) := by
  classical
  have hdot : ∀ e : PauliRegister P,
      dotProduct (r • indicatorVec u) e = lowDegreeEnc e u * r := by
    intro e
    rw [lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct]
    simp only [dotProduct, Finset.sum_mul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring
  have hp : ∀ e : PauliRegister P,
      phaseSign (binTrace (PauliScalar P) (dotProduct (r • indicatorVec u) e)) =
        phaseSign (pauliTraceBit P u r e) := by
    intro e
    rw [hdot e]
    rfl
  rw [tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e (_ : e ∈ Finset.univ) => by rw [hp e]),
    ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (Finset.univ : Finset (PauliRegister P))
      (fun e => pauliTraceBit P u r e = 0)]
  have hfilter :
      (Finset.univ.filter fun e : PauliRegister P => ¬ pauliTraceBit P u r e = 0) =
        Finset.univ.filter fun e : PauliRegister P => pauliTraceBit P u r e = 1 := by

private def pauliEdgeSwap (e : PauliEdge) : PauliEdge :=
  ⟨(e.val.2, e.val.1), by
    have he := e.2
    rwa [Sym2.eq_swap] at he⟩

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: reversal of ordered edges is an involutive
equivalence of the Pauli edge type. -/
private def pauliEdgeSwapEquiv : PauliEdge ≃ PauliEdge where
  toFun := pauliEdgeSwap
  invFun := pauliEdgeSwap
  left_inv := fun _ => rfl
  right_inv := fun _ => rfl

/-- Symmetry of the Pauli question distribution in the symmetric game appearing
in `lem:pauli-completeness`. -/
theorem pauliQuestionDistribution_symm (P : AdmissibleParams)
    (x y : PauliQuestion P) :
    (pauliQuestionDistribution P).weight (x, y) =
      (pauliQuestionDistribution P).weight (y, x) := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty PauliEdge := pauliEdge_nonempty
  have hcard : ∀ c : PauliQuestion P × PauliQuestion P,
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (PauliEdge × PauliSpace P)).filter fun q =>
          ((q.1.val.1, pauliCL P q.1.val.1 q.2),
            (q.1.val.2, pauliCL P q.1.val.2 q.2)) = c).card =
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (PauliEdge × PauliSpace P)).filter fun q =>
          ((q.1.val.1, pauliCL P q.1.val.1 q.2),
            (q.1.val.2, pauliCL P q.1.val.2 q.2)) = c.swap).card := by
    intro c
    refine Finset.card_equiv
      (Equiv.prodCongr pauliEdgeSwapEquiv (Equiv.refl (PauliSpace P))) ?_
    intro q
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro hq
      change Prod.swap (((q.1.val.1, pauliCL P q.1.val.1 q.2),
        (q.1.val.2, pauliCL P q.1.val.2 q.2))) = c.swap
      rw [hq]
    · intro hq
      have hq' : Prod.swap (((q.1.val.1, pauliCL P q.1.val.1 q.2),
        (q.1.val.2, pauliCL P q.1.val.2 q.2))) = c.swap := hq
      simpa using congrArg Prod.swap hq'
  change ((uniformDistribution (PauliEdge × PauliSpace P)).map
      (fun q => ((q.1.val.1, pauliCL P q.1.val.1 q.2),
        (q.1.val.2, pauliCL P q.1.val.2 q.2)))).weight (x, y) =
    ((uniformDistribution (PauliEdge × PauliSpace P)).map
      (fun q => ((q.1.val.1, pauliCL P q.1.val.1 q.2),
        (q.1.val.2, pauliCL P q.1.val.2 q.2)))).weight (y, x)
  rw [uniform_map_weight, uniform_map_weight, hcard (x, y), Prod.swap_prod_mk]

/-- Symmetry of the Pauli decision predicate in the symmetric game appearing in
`lem:pauli-completeness`. -/
theorem pauliWinPredicate_symm (P : AdmissibleParams)
    (x y : PauliQuestion P) (a b : PauliAnswer P) :
    pauliWinPredicate P x y a b = pauliWinPredicate P y x b a := by
  obtain ⟨tA, xA⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨tB, xB⟩ := y
  by_cases hT : tA = tB
  · subst hT
    simp only [pauliWinPredicate]
    rw [Bool.and_comm (validPauliAnswer tA b) (validPauliAnswer tA a)]
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · simp [hab]
    · simp [hab, Ne.symm hab]
  · cases hvA : validPauliAnswer tA a
    · simp [pauliWinPredicate, hvA]
    · cases hvB : validPauliAnswer tB b
      · simp [pauliWinPredicate, hvB]
      · simp only [pauliWinPredicate, hvA, hvB, Bool.and_self,
          if_neg hT, if_neg (Ne.symm hT)]
        rcases tA with (_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|_|(iA|jA) <;>
          rcases a with uA|fA|gA|bitsA|bitA|trA|hhA <;>
          (try exact Bool.noConfusion hvA) <;>
          rcases tB with (_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|_|(iB|jB) <;>
          rcases b with uB|fB|gB|bitsB|bitB|trB|hhB <;>
          (try exact Bool.noConfusion hvB) <;>
          rfl

/-- The symmetric presentation of the Pauli basis test. The field and basis
are those fixed by `P.model`; no additional model is quantified. -/
noncomputable def pauliBasisTestSymm (P : AdmissibleParams) : SymmetricGame where
  Question := PauliQuestion P
  Answer := PauliAnswer P
  μ := pauliQuestionDistribution P
  μ_prob := (pauliBasisTest P).μ_prob
  μ_symm := pauliQuestionDistribution_symm P
  decide := pauliWinPredicate P
  decide_symm := pauliWinPredicate_symm P

/-- The symmetric presentation has the Pauli basis test as its
underlying game. -/
theorem pauliBasisTestSymm_toGame (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    (pauliBasisTestSymm P).toGame = pauliBasisTest P := by
  rfl

value-one SPCC strategy. Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:390-395`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1229-1421`. -/
theorem exists_spcc_value_one (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    ∃ S : SymmetricStrategy (pauliBasisTestSymm P),
      S.IsSPCC ∧ S.toStrategy.value = 1 := by
  sorry

end

/-- Incompatible fibers of two coarse-grainings of one projective measurement
have zero product. -/
theorem postprocess_effect_mul_eq_zero_of_incompatible {ζ α β V : Type*}
    [Fintype ζ] [DecidableEq ζ] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (M : Measurement ζ V) (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
    (f : ζ → α) (g : ζ → β) (a : α) (b : β)
